# Staff Product Manager

$172k - $215k

Fuze Health

[Florida, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Florida%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3474468873178910317?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9630&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1243631546462319689&crId=US_0US_0)

## **Job Summary** At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs. Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.

## **Job Description**

The Staff Product Manager at FuzeRx is a senior individual contributor role responsible for defining, shaping, and delivering high-impact product initiatives that advance patient care, pharmacy operations, and strategic growth. This role sits within the Product Management job family and represents the highest level of product craftsmanship and influence without direct people management.

As a Staff Product Manager, you will operate with significant autonomy, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Clinical, Pharmacy Operations, Data, and Business leaders to solve complex problems at scale. This role is expected to set product standards, influence product strategy across domains, and mentor other Product Managers while driving measurable outcomes aligned with FuzeRx’s mission and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for complex, high-impact product areas, from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, and optimization

- Define product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmaps aligned to company goals, patient outcomes, and operational efficiency

- Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Data, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business and clinical needs into clear product requirements

- Lead product discovery through customer research, data analysis, experimentation, and validation to ensure solutions solve real user problems

- Drive alignment across senior stakeholders by clearly articulating tradeoffs, priorities, and outcomes using data and strong product judgment

- Establish and monitor success metrics (KPIs/OKRs), using insights to iterate and continuously improve product performance

- Anticipate regulatory, operational, and technical constraints in healthcare and pharmacy environments and design scalable, compliant solutions

- Serve as a product thought leader and mentor, raising the bar for product quality, execution, and decision-making across the Product organization


**Required Experience & Qualifications:**

Minimum Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, including ownership of complex, cross-functional product initiatives

- Demonstrated experience leading products from concept to launch in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Experience working closely with Engineering teams in agile development environments

- Strong analytical skills with experience defining and using product metrics to drive decision-making

- Experience operating in regulated or highly complex domains (e.g., healthcare, pharmacy, fintech, or enterprise platforms)

- Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without authority

- Proficiency with common product and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Figma, Productboard, Slack, GSuite)


Preferred Qualifications:

- MBA or advanced degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Data, or a related field

- Experience building products for pharmacy, healthcare services, life sciences, or medication management platforms

- Experience with data-driven personalization, automation, or AI-enabled product capabilities

- Proven track record of setting product strategy at the portfolio or platform level

- Experience mentoring or coaching other Product Managers and contributing to product org maturity


## **Additional Information**

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. At this time, Fuze Health is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa.

Travel: No - Required up to 0% of the time

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.

_Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship._

**Salary and Benefits**

Compensation Range: $172,000-$215,000/annually

The compensation range provided reflects the applicable national market range for this role and may vary based on the candidate's geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

Commission Eligible: No

Annual Incentive Bonus Eligible: Yes

Equity Eligible: Yes

Benefits: Full-time employee benefits include: dental, vision, and multiple group medical plans to choose from, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, group life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, flexible spending account (FSA) and health savings account (HSA), commuter benefits, employer-paid short-term (STD) and long-term disability (LTD) insurance, and additional supplemental insurance plans (spouse life insurance, legal insurance, an employee assistance program, home health testing kits, and a fertility medication discount program). Employees are also provided flexible vacation time, accrued paid sick time, 10 paid holidays, (2 floating holidays for full time non-exempt employees) , and eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees, additional paid weeks for the birthing parent, 4 weeks paid caregiver leave, and a Lifestyle Spending Account allowance each month.

More Benefits Information Here: Fuze Health Benefits Site .

Application deadline: October 31, 2026

# Staff Product Manager, Atlas Infinite

$151k - $297k

MongoDB HQ

[California](https://jooble.org/jobs/California)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4972962648564338575?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7034741984759506456&crId=US_0US_0)

The Staff Product Manager is an Individual Contributor (IC) product leader responsible for a broad platform surface for Atlas Infinite at MongoDB. Atlas Infinite is the largest architectural innovation in MongoDB Atlas ever, purpose-built to handle today's speed and scale of development and demand.

In this position, you will own and solve end-to-end problems around the user experience and database experience of Atlas Infinite, including but limited to feature discovery, activation, monetization, and retention. You will see patterns, opportunities, and risks across areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, establish reusable standards for PM craft, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You have deep knowledge of cloud database platforms, distributed data systems, and enterprise product development.

This role can be based out of a MongoDB office or remotely in the United States.

### Responsibilities

- Interlinked Vision & Multi-Year Bets: Set and champion a product vision across Atlas Infinite's capabilities, while actively discovering opportunities that are not on today's roadmap or fit any single team's remit. Branching, on-demand compute, and instant recovery are examples of possible bets. Make the case for investment and prioritization, including build-vs-buy considerations, and distinguish exploratory vision from release commitments
- Cross-Team Execution: Along with program management, own execution health across workstreams, negotiating sequencing, scope, and resource trade-offs with engineering leaders and peer PMs where you have no direct authority. Ensure preview-to-GA readiness, roadmaps, and dependencies across database, storage, Atlas platform, migration, backup, security, and cloud infrastructure teams are aligned and connect to company objectives
- Execution & Research Standards: Establish lightweight operating practices and shared customer/market research frameworks that make workload qualification, customer-representative testing, win/loss analysis, launch readiness, and post-launch learning consistent across the portfolio. Use data to drive decisions without overburdening delivery teams
- Product Health: Resolve complex post-launch escalations when the root cause spans architecture, performance, migration, observability, supportability, or unclear ownership. Turn customer and operational signals into systemic product fixes rather than one-off workarounds
- Customer Discovery: Identify needs and competitive dynamics that cut across product areas. Look beyond requests from today's customers to discover emerging jobs-to-be-done, surprising uses of the architecture, and reasons customers do not choose MongoDB at all. Combine interviews, workload and pricing evidence, product analytics, field feedback, and experiments to test known hypotheses and uncover unknowns; reorient the roadmap when the evidence warrants it
- Outbound & GTM: Partner with product marketing, pricing, sales, solutions architecture, customer success, documentation, and support on high-stakes customer engagements, product positioning, and omni-channel marketing. Establish ideal customer profile; ensure claims and migration guidance match demonstrated capabilities; translate successful adoption and enablement approaches into shared playbooks
- Executive Alignment: Synthesize customer experience, technical readiness, adoption, and commercial impact into clear, confident product stories for senior leadership. Surface cross-area risks and progress early, including trade-offs between new-workload growth, customer savings, and changes to existing Atlas usage
- Mentorship: Mentor PMs across the area, sharing frameworks for cross-team alignment, customer evidence, technical trade-offs, multi-year bets, and leadership communication

### Qualifications

- Strong technical fluency in cloud databases, distributed data systems, storage infrastructure, developer experiences, or an adjacent developer platform. - A demonstrated ability to discover opportunities beyond the current roadmap: connect technical possibilities to unmet customer needs, formulate and test hypotheses, notice surprising patterns, and change direction when evidence challenges the original thesis
- Experience taking a complex product from early adoption toward dependable, broader use while protecting space for longer-term innovation; able to make explicit trade-offs among customer trust, technical readiness, speed, and investment

- Commercial and analytical judgment: able to assess workload-level value, adoption and usage evidence, competitive alternatives, pricing and unit economics, and the impact of a new product on an existing portfolio. Comfortable with build-vs-buy questions where relevant
- Ability to raise the quality of customer discovery and product decision-making across teams through useful shared methods and mentorship, without mistaking more process for better outcomes
- Exceptional communication skills: able to explain a technical and commercial thesis, its uncertainties, and the evidence that would change your mind to engineers, customers, executives, and go-to-market partners

**At Instructure** , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Instructure is seeking a collaborative and experienced Senior Product Manager to champion our shared components and cross-product initiatives across the business. You will shepherd cross-product programs tied to core services that govern customer configuration, platform management, security initiatives and more. In this highly collaborative role, you will own the product roadmaps, working hand-in-hand with other product managers, engineering teams, UX/UI designers, customers, legal counsel, and compliance officers.

You will act as a strategic partner to other product development teams, understanding their needs and empowering them with technical services and best practices in platform development strategy. You’ll use AI to streamline development, design, and delivery as well as look for opportunities to bring AI features to market. In short, you’ll enjoy the ability to deliver with an aligned engineering team while also embracing the challenge of achieving success through collaborative efforts.

**Responsibilities:**

- **Product Strategy & Roadmap:** Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for our cross-product platform services capabilities and features; aligning with overall business goals and regulatory requirements, developed in close collaboration with internal stakeholders.

- **Shared Services Management:** Proactively engage with internal development teams to identify, prioritize, and define the development of reusable components, libraries, and patterns that promote consistency, efficiency, and compliance across our products, acting as a key partner in their development workflows.

- **Collaboration & Communication:** Foster strong working relationships and effectively communicate the product vision, roadmap, and progress to stakeholders across engineering, design, legal, compliance, and executive teams, actively soliciting feedback and incorporating it into the product development process.

- **Internal Customer Engagement:** Build empathy for our internal development teams, understanding their pain points and needs related to application development and translating these insights into the roadmap. Leverage strong relationships to advocate for best practices and define success through adoption.

- **Requirements Definition:** Translate business needs and compliance requirements into clear and detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications, ensuring alignment and understanding with engineering and design partners.

- **Product Lifecycle Management:** Manage the entire product lifecycle from ideation to launch, iteration, and retirement, ensuring continuous improvement and adherence to compliance standards, with ongoing communication and collaboration with internal teams.

- **Performance Monitoring:** Define and track key metrics to measure the adoption, performance, and impact of our front-end shared services and compliance initiatives, sharing these insights with internal stakeholders to drive continuous improvement.

- **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Lead and inspire cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented environment, emphasizing partnership and shared ownership with internal customers.

- **Staying Informed:** Continuously monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and changes in relevant regulations to proactively adapt our product strategy, sharing relevant information and insights with internal teams.


**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Product Management or a related field.

- 4+ years of experience in product management or technical product management, ideally with a significant focus on platform services and components.

- Experience applying modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows to accelerate learning cycles, experimentation, and delivery.

- Strong understanding of front-end and back-end development principles, frameworks, and best practices.

- Demonstrated experience in building and managing shared component libraries or platform solutions, with a track record of successful collaboration with engineering teams.

- Knowledge of and experience with user management and permissions in complex org structures including cross-org trusts or consortiums is a plus.

- **Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships and influence cross-functional teams, particularly engineering and design.**

- Proven ability to translate complex technical and legal requirements into clear and concise product specifications, ensuring shared understanding with internal partners.

- Experience working in an Agile development environment, with a strong emphasis on collaboration and iterative development.

## **About Nava** Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges. As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

## _**Please note: the level of the role will be determined by Nava leadership based on experience and skillset.**_

## **Position summary**

Nava is at the forefront of reimagining how our government serves its people, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive our vision forward.

You'll help us execute our mission of reimagining the digital services our government provides. Working directly with government partners and across Nava’s engineering, design, and business teams, you’ll create experiences that improve the lives of millions of Americans. You care deeply about end users and are passionate about crafting simple and usable solutions.

You'll work with government partners and cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and project managers to set direction, scope product features, remove obstacles and barriers, and assess the business impact on a government contract.

You will be uniquely positioned and empowered to make a huge impact on Nava's mission to reimagine how our government serves its people.

You think holistically and take pride in working through highly ambiguous situations to deliver value to users. You have a strong bias towards action when faced with incomplete information and communicate transparently to build consensus internally and externally.

## What you'll do

- Define the vision, goals, and measures of success for the products and services you manage
- Work with designers, business analysts, and technical leads to discover and synthesize market research, user needs, business requirements, and technical approaches
- Define the direction, scope, and priority of projects, from high-level initiatives to specific features, user stories, and business metrics
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and ship projects
- Proactively socialize, iterate on, and build buy-in for product initiatives with the team, government partners, and other contractors
- Collaborate with the project management team to prioritize roadmaps and inbound units of work
- Represent Nava’s outcome-centric and user-centric approach in discovery meetings with agencies and contractors
- Understand and communicate the needs of end users and population segments we serve and government partners we work with
- Measure product progress toward business goals or user needs and translate data insights into action
- Make tactical decisions to improve the design, define requirements, and generate stakeholder buy-in for our desired path forward

## Required skills

- At least 10 years of experience as a Product Manager of a cross-functional team
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
- Experience running and/or shipping consumer web applications
- Ability to generate very strong product plans and build buy-in across the team, our government partners, and other contractors
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical, user experience, and project management trade-offs; enthusiastic communicator
- Strong bias towards action; ability to step up into team gaps and ambiguous situations to structure the team’s action plan
- Ability to execute with incomplete information; great product instincts and an ability to create order from divergent needs
- Ability to define a product objective and logically reverse engineer the path and communications to achieve the objective
- Ability to identify market trends and shifts that will affect product direction and update plans based on future expectations
- An adaptive, empathetic, collaborative, and positive mindset

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for an experienced **Principal Product Manager** to lead the strategy and execution of the payments platform and experiences that help drive the accelerated growth we’ve experienced across our Grading and Marketplace business lines, including our **Liquidity offerings** and Digital Repacking product ( **Power Packs**).

Money movement sits underneath nearly everything Collectors does. Every grading submission, vault transaction, marketplace sale, consignment payout, among other transactional experiences relies on a payment stack that has to be fast, resilient, cost-effective and compliant across a growing number of business models and expanding globally. This role will own that stack outright: how funds come in, how funds go out, how they are routed and how customers see and control their money in our products.

You will work with stakeholders across our Marketplace and Grading business lines, Finance and Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk, as well as other Product and Tech partner teams, with regular exposure to the executive team.

**What You'll Do**

- Own the payments strategy and roadmap. Set a multi-year direction for the payment platform that serves today's revenue lines and anticipates the ones we haven't launched yet. Sequence platform investment against near-term business commitments and defend those tradeoffs with executives.

- Build a wallet that customers can use across our products and platforms. Own balance and activity views, top-up, withdrawal, and split-pay, turning stored value from a settlement mechanism into a reason customers choose us.

- Take payments international. Deliver the payment, currency, and local method capabilities, partnering with Tax and Legal on registration, reporting obligations including DAC7, and market-by-market compliance.

- Run money-in and money-out end to end. Acquiring, alternative payment methods, payouts, settlement, funding patterns, and reconciliation, including the ledger and reporting foundation Finance depends on for accurate, timely close.

- Drive orchestration and cost optimization. Own multi-PSP routing, least-cost routing, failover and redundancy, retry and decline strategy, and network-level economics. Treat authorization rate and cost per transaction as products you are accountable for, not metrics you report on.

- Partner internally with Risk and Fraud teams to reduce payment fraud and dispute loss, transaction screening, chargeback and dispute workflows, and the approval-rate-versus-loss tradeoff.


**Who You Are**

- 8+ years in product management, with deep payments or consumer fintech experience. You have owned production payment systems at meaningful scale, not adjacent surfaces. Senior IC experience at a high-growth marketplace, fintech, or platform company is preferable.

- Fluent in the payments stack. Card networks and interchange, gateway and PSP integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, or comparable), tokenization, 3DS and SCA, alternative and local payment methods, payouts, and dispute lifecycles. You know where the money and the failure modes actually live.

- Experienced in cross-border payments. You have launched payments into new countries and navigated currency, local methods, and regulatory and tax reporting requirements with Legal and Compliance partners.

- Experience with a marketplace, where pricing, promotions, and payment mechanics all pull on the same supply-and-demand levers.

- Rigorous and decisive under ambiguity. You use data and experimentation where they apply, make high-conviction calls where they don't, and take full accountability for the outcome.

- A clear communicator who builds alignment without authority. You compress complexity for executives and hold the line on detail with the teams building it.

- Nice to have: Strong on financial operations. You have built or materially improved ledger, settlement, and reconciliation systems, and you have worked shoulder to shoulder with Accounting through close.

**About the Company**

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to contribute to product strategy for Armada's federal and defense-facing solutions. You will engage directly with defense and government customers to understand mission and warfighter edge compute requirements, translate them into clear product requirements, and work cross-functionally to close capability gaps across Armada's hardware, platform, monitoring, and ISV application layers.

This is a hands-on role for a self-starting product manager operating at the intersection of Armada's product organization and the defense and intelligence community. You will determine your own methods and approach on new assignments, exercise judgment across ambiguous and sensitive requirements, and frequently advise engineering, field, capture, and go-to-market partners on product matters within the federal domain. You'll also help build and champion standardization across the team — establishing consistent processes, frameworks, and best practices that scale with our growth.

In this role, you will define and deliver platform capabilities that meet the unique requirements of defense, intelligence, and federal mission environments, such as disconnected operations, classified workloads, zero-trust security, and compliance with government standards, while maintaining alignment with Armada's commercial platform roadmap.

**Location & Clearance**

- Location: This role is remote within the United States, with periodic travel to customer sites and Armada offices
- Clearance: An active Top Secret (TS) or Secret clearance is strongly preferred; candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
- Team: This role sits on Armada's Federal PM team and reports to the Federal product lead

**What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)**

**Customer Requirements & Mission Understanding**

- Engage directly with defense and government customers to understand edge compute requirements for warfighter and other mission-critical scenarios
- Translate complex defense customer problems into clear, specific, and actionable product requirements
- Identify and prioritize gaps in Armada's solution set - spanning hardware, platform, monitoring, and ISV applications - needed to address defense and federal use cases

**Product Ownership & Delivery**

- Contribute to the roadmap for Armada's federal product area, from requirements definition through development, QA, and launch
- Partner with engineering to scope and deliver solutions that meet defense-grade requirements for security, reliability, and mission assurance
- Determine methods and approach on new initiatives, exercising independent judgment given ambiguous, sensitive, or classified requirements

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

- Serve as the primary product interface between defense customers, field teams, and engineering
- Advise sales, capture, and field teams on technical and product strategy for federal opportunities
- Support proposal development, technical evaluations, and customer briefings as the product subject matter expert for federal solutions
- Translate mission requirements from DoD, IC, and federal agencies into scalable platform capabilities
- Balance classified and unclassified customer needs while maintaining a unified core product architecture
- Drive secure edge-to-cloud capabilities supporting disconnected, intermittent, and denied environments
- Partner with security and compliance teams on DoD security requirements, NIST, RMF, and zero-trust architectures, including classified and air-gapped deployment models
- Guide product features needed to support ATO processes and government compliance requirements

**Required Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience, Master's and 6+ years, or PhD and 3+ years, with 5+ years in product management for infrastructure, platform, cloud, or defense-related compute products
- Active U.S. security clearance at the Secret level required
- Experience in the defense industry, particularly around compute used in warfighter or other mission-critical scenarios
- Demonstrated ability to understand defense customer problems and translate them into specific, actionable product requirements
- Strong background in distributed systems, cloud platforms, edge computing, or infrastructure software
- Demonstrated ability to determine methods on new assignments and exercise judgment across variable, ambiguous factors
- Excellent written and verbal communication with technical, defense, and business audiences
- Direct experience supporting U.S. Government or Defense customers (DoD, IC, or federal agencies)
- Strong understanding of mission environments, classified systems, and defense operational constraints
- Familiarity with secure system design, zero-trust principles, and classified deployment models
- U.S. Citizenship required

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Active TS/SCI clearance
- Experience with ISV application ecosystems within defense or government environments
- Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native technologies
- Experience delivering hardware-integrated or edge computing products for defense, industrial, or public sector customers
- Experience with edge computing platforms in defense or austere environments
- Experience supporting ATO processes or RMF documentation
- Prior military, intelligence, or government service experience

# Senior Product Manager

Full-time

WhiteTech

[Georgia](https://jooble.org/jobs/Georgia)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8514445216065054105?p=1&pos=0&rgn=11&pageType=7&jobAge=450&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4477767931397882050&crId=US_0US_0)

**At WhiteTech, we empower businesses in the financial ecosystem with cutting-edge white-label and SAAS solutions.**

Our comprehensive suite of tools is tailored for EMI, PSP, e-commerce, and open banking platforms. With WhiteTech, clients gain access to a platform designed for flexibility, scalability, and seamless integration.

Our mission is to help businesses unlock their full potential in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

Whether scaling your PSP, enhancing your EMI services, or diving into open banking, **WhiteTech is your partner for innovation and growth.**

_We are a remote-first technology company and welcome applications from candidates across Europe, including the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, and other non-EEA European countries such as Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, Montenegro, Turkey, and the Western Balkans. We also consider applicants from different locations who can work within Central European Time (CET)._

## **Your Role and Impact:**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Product Manager** to take ownership of one of our strategic products from vision to execution. You will be responsible for defining product strategy, shaping the roadmap, delivering MVPs, and driving continuous product growth.

In this role, you will own the product throughout its entire lifecycle—from identifying customer needs and defining product strategy to measuring business impact and continuously improving the product. Working closely with engineering, design, QA, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will build scalable fintech products that solve real customer problems while supporting the company’s business objectives.

## **Your Key Responsibilities:**

#### **Product Strategy & Vision**

- Define and own the product vision, strategy, and long-term roadmap.
- Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and business priorities through customer interactions and market research.
- Define MVP scope and continuously evolve the product based on customer feedback and business impact.
- Balance customer value, technical feasibility, and business goals when making product decisions.
- Engage directly with customers, partners, and key stakeholders to validate product direction.

#### **Product Discovery & Planning**

- Lead product discovery through customer interviews, user research, and competitor analysis.
- Gather and prioritize product requirements from stakeholders.
- Create and maintain a well-structured product backlog.
- Define product KPIs and measurable business outcomes.
- Prioritize initiatives based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.

#### **Stakeholder & Customer Management**

- Build trusted relationships with customers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
- Gather customer feedback and translate insights into product improvements.
- Present product strategy, roadmap, and product performance to senior leadership.
- Serve as the primary product representative for internal and external stakeholders.

#### **Product Delivery**

- Own product delivery from discovery to release.
- Collaborate with engineering, QA, and design throughout the product lifecycle.
- Ensure features deliver customer and business value.
- Support Agile delivery and continuous product improvement.

#### **Cross-functional Leadership**

- Lead cross-functional teams consisting of engineers, QA specialists, designers, and analysts.
- Coordinate work with external vendors, technology providers, and third-party integrations when required.
- Facilitate planning sessions, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and roadmap discussions.
- Ensure transparency through Jira, Confluence, BigPicture, or similar tools.

#### **Product Performance & Growth**

- Monitor product performance using qualitative and quantitative data.
- Measure feature adoption, product KPIs, and business impact to continuously optimize the product.
- Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve activation, conversion, retention, and operational efficiency.
- Define product improvement initiatives based on data and customer feedback.
- Support product scaling after MVP launch.
- Continuously optimize user experience and internal operational workflows.

#### **Risk & Quality Management**

- Identify product risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
- Coordinate release readiness and ensure high-quality product launches.
- Define clear acceptance criteria and collaborate with QA to ensure product quality throughout the development lifecycle.
- Work closely with compliance, regulatory, and technical stakeholders when required.
- Support continuous improvement of product quality and delivery processes.

## **Requirements & Skills:**

- 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager in product or technology-driven companies.
- Proven experience owning products from discovery through delivery and growth.
- Experience working directly with customers, enterprise clients, or business stakeholders.
- Strong experience defining product vision, roadmap, and MVP strategy.
- Experience working with Agile product development methodologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Experience prioritizing backlogs and making data-driven product decisions.
- Experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UI/UX, and business stakeholders.
- Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, and product management tools.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
- English proficiency: Upper-Intermediate+.

## **Nice to Have:**

- Experience building products from scratch (0→1).
- Experience launching MVPs and scaling products.
- Experience in FinTech, Payments, Banking, KYC/KYB, Compliance, Card Issuing, or SaaS.
- Experience working with third-party integrations and external vendors.
- Experience leading distributed remote teams.
- Certifications such as PSPO, Scrum Product Owner, Agile, or similar.

## **Our Hiring Process:**

1. **Application Screening**
2. **Interview Stages (2-3 weeks)**
 - **Prescreening Call with recruiter** (40 min)
 - **Technical Interview** (60 min)
 - **Final interview**(60 min)
3. **Job Offer & Background Check**

**We offer:**

- Competitive compensation package (commensurate with your experience)
- 19 business days of flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
- Fully remote work with flexible hours (within the CET time zone) from any location of your choice
- Values-driven culture with a friendly and supportive work environment
- Opportunity to regularly participate in conferences and community events as both a participant and contributor
- Matrix organizational structure designed to streamline communication, remove barriers, and promote efficiency

# Senior Product Manager, Kubernetes & Cluster Lifecycle

Full-time

Spectro Cloud

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1649024221550074124?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=522&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3400524992583746537&crId=US_0US_0)

**Who we are**

Spectro Cloud is the AI and Kubernetes infrastructure platform behind some of the most demanding environments in the world. Our platform lets enterprises manage the full infrastructure stack, from bare metal to production AI, across data centers, clouds, edge, and air-gapped environments, at fleet scale: some of our customers run thousands of clusters with a handful of engineers.

**About the role**

Kubernetes is becoming the common infrastructure abstraction under three classes of workloads: VMs, containers, and AI. Multi-cluster management is where that abstraction becomes real, and it's the foundation the rest of our platform stands on. Enterprises come to us with heterogeneous estates: public cloud and managed Kubernetes (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, EKS, AKS, GKE, etc.), on-prem (vSphere, Nutanix, bare metal), all built on Cluster API, some created with our platform, others built outside it. Your job is to make every one of them a first-class citizen: declared, reconciled, and operated with the same rigor regardless of substrate, with no snowflakes.

You will own one of the most established product areas in the company, with a large enterprise and public sector customer base, and drive its next chapter: making multi-cluster infrastructure the substrate that AI workloads run on, adopting clusters built outside our platform as first-class citizens, keeping pace with upstream Kubernetes and Cluster API, and turning long-term support into a product enterprises can buy.

This is a deep domain role. You'll work daily with senior engineering leads and large enterprise customers. It rewards technical fluency and judgment about what not to build.

**What you will own**

- **Infrastructure for AI workloads:** bare metal and private cloud as the high-performance substrate for GPU clusters, in partnership with our AI product area. Multi-cluster is where AI factories actually run.

- **Cluster lifecycle across every substrate:** provisioning, upgrades, scaling, and Day-2 operations for clusters on public clouds, private clouds, and bare metal, including the customer-facing side of platform transitions: when the ecosystem moves and clusters must follow, you own the migration experience and its communication.

- **Brownfield adoption and federation:** the strategic direction of the area. Take clusters built outside our platform from read-only visibility to fully managed, without disruption.

- **Long-term support as a product:** LTS for Kubernetes versions and workloads, vendor relationships that back it, and the version support policy customers plan against.

- **Estate organization and multi-tenancy:** how enterprises carve up large cluster estates with tenant and team boundaries, shared versus dedicated clusters, bringing existing clusters under management, and the access and isolation model that makes one platform safe for many teams.

- This map will evolve. The portfolio is growing faster than the org chart, and PMs here regularly take ownership of new product areas as they emerge, including products not yet announced. Expect your scope to expand as the platform does, deliberately and in dialogue with you.


**How you will work**

- Evidence over opinion: usage telemetry and customer signals over the loudest voice, including your own.

- Commitments are commitments: this area ships on release trains with enterprise customers planning around dates. Refined epics, explicit scope, honest slip communication.

- One org: PM, UX, and Docs operate as a single group; you bring design and documentation in at the definition stage.

- AI-native by default: we expect every PM to multiply their output with AI tooling, daily.

- Remote-first across US, EU, and India time zones. Clear async writing is how decisions happen here.


**Minimum Qualifications**

We don't expect the ideal candidate to check every box. The items below are what we look for; don't let a gap discourage you from applying.

- 5+ years of product management on infrastructure products, with hands-on exposure to 2 or more platform families: ideally one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, or their managed Kubernetes services) and one on-prem (vSphere, Nutanix, bare metal).

- Real Kubernetes depth: you understand cluster lifecycle, upgrades, and operators well enough to earn the respect of senior engineers and enterprise platform teams. Cluster API familiarity is a strong plus.

- Judgment about maturity: this area includes fast-moving strategic work and stable surfaces that need discipline more than features. You can tell which is which and invest accordingly.

- Comfort with upstream ecosystems: you understand what tracking upstream Kubernetes costs and buys. Participation in CNCF SIGs, working groups, or open source communities is a plus, not a bar.

- Clear written communication across time zones and cultures.

- CKA/CKAD or similar hands-on Kubernetes certification is a nice signal, never a requirement.


**The hiring process**

Your time is valuable, so the process is short and each stage has a purpose:

- **Screening interview (30 min):** mutual fit and a walk through your experience.

- **Product interview (60 min):** a working session on a real problem from this domain. We're looking at how you think, scope, and decide.

- **Technical depth interview (45 min):** Kubernetes and infrastructure fluency, with one of our senior engineering leads.

- **Culture and team interview (30 min):** working in a team setting, alignment with our core values.


**Why this role**

- Foundation product area with a loyal enterprise and public sector base, and a clear strategic direction into brownfield federation and AI infrastructure.

- Small senior team, direct access to founders, engineering leadership, and customers.

- Real ownership: this domain has one PM, and it's you.

# Senior Product Manager, Growth (global)

Full-time

beehiiv

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

beehiiv is the all-in-one newsletter and creator platform powering the next generation of media companies and independent voices. We help creators and businesses launch, grow, and monetize newsletters—now serving tens of thousands of publishers and reaching hundreds of millions of readers monthly. With $40M+ ARR, 100% YoY growth, and a newly expanded product suite (ad network, podcast, community, website builder, paid tiers), we’re entering our next phase of hypergrowth.

As our Senior Product Manager, Growth, you will own the most important stretch of the beehiiv journey: from the moment someone signs up to the moment they become a paying customer—signup, onboarding, activation, upsells, and trial-to-paid conversion. It’s yours, end to end. You’ll be 100% dedicated to growth, working hand in hand with our Growth & Marketing team, and you’ll take over an active roadmap of onboarding and conversion experiments on day one.

This is not a traditional “write the spec and hand it off” PM role. We’re looking for an AI-native operator who can go from a data insight to a hypothesis to a working prototype in a day — using AI tools and our design system to produce near-finished designs yourself, and shipping alongside engineering without waiting on a designer for every experiment. Growth work here is outcome-based: a scrappier onboarding that converts better beats a beautiful one that doesn’t. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and the PMs who own our core product surfaces.

Compensation will be based on experience and location. Ideally, this candidate can work PST hours and access the site from their location.

Ideally, you will have:

- 5+ years of experience in product management, with meaningful time spent owning growth, activation, onboarding, or monetization in a product-led SaaS business (not just core product/feature work)
- A track record of moving a conversion metric — ideally free/trial-to-paid — through a high-velocity experimentation program: scoping A/B tests, sizing them properly, reading results honestly, and iterating fast
- Strong analytical skills: you can self-serve in SQL and product analytics tools (e.g. Metabase, Amplitude, FullStory), break a blended number down by cohort, channel, and device, and tell the difference between a mix shift and a real product regression
- AI-native ways of working: you already use tools like Claude, Cursor, or similar every day to prototype, analyze data, and write — and you’re comfortable producing engineer-ready PRDs plus near-finished prototypes within an existing design system
- Good product and design taste, with the judgment to know which experiments can go straight from your prototype to production and which need a product designer’s input
- Experience across the full trial funnel — onboarding flows, in-product upsells, paywalls and checkout, pricing and packaging, lifecycle and trial-expiry messaging — and how mobile and desktop users behave differently
- Excellent communication and writing skills — you can clearly explain hypotheses, results, and trade-offs to cross-functional stakeholders, including leadership
- Prior experience in the newsletter / media / creator / publishing / SaaS industry a plus
- Strong organization skills: able to work independently with little direction when necessary
- Genuine excitement about scaling a fast-growing platform
- An ownership mentality


What you’ll be responsible for:

- Owning signup, onboarding, activation, upsells, and trial-to-paid conversion — and be accountable for the metrics that matter most: trial start rate, activation, and paid conversion
- Own and prioritize the growth roadmap, weighing impact against effort with engineering, and run a steady cadence of experiments from hypothesis through readout
- Fix the highest-friction moments in the funnel: the mobile-first experience and mobile-to-desktop handoff, trial start, checkout, and getting new users to their first “aha” moment (first post sent, first subscribers imported, website live)
- Design upsell and trial experiences that let users actually experience our most valuable features — like automations, custom domains, and team collaboration — before they hit a paywall
- Build agent-first onboarding: define how users set up beehiiv through AI agents (via our MCP) as well as in-app, including AI-assisted onboarding inside the product
- Turn signups that didn’t convert in their trial — including high-value and returning accounts — into paying customers through lifecycle, offers, and trial-period experiments
- Partner with Growth Marketing on acquisition quality, paid funnels, and lifecycle messaging, so that what happens before and after signup works as one system
- Define success metrics and event tracking up front for every experiment, so we always know what moved and why
- Prototype and design your own experiments using AI and our design system, and work with our product designers on higher-ambiguity problems
- Collaborate closely with the PMs who own core product surfaces (editor, website, monetization) on activation moments that cut across their areas
- Present your thinking, results, and trade-offs to the product and leadership team, and incorporate feedback quickly

Why this role might be for you:

- Join a fast-growing start-up and own a dedicated growth surface that hasn’t had a single owner before
- High impact and high visibility — your work directly moves revenue and shapes the first impression of every beehiiv user
- You’re an AI-native builder who wants the autonomy to go from idea to shipped experiment without waiting in a queue
- You’re autonomous and excited about owning projects end to end, from problem framing through shipped experiment
- Excited about new challenges and executing creative solutions in an ambiguous, fast-moving surface area

Why this role might not be for you:

- Not a traditional 9-to-5 position
- Need to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
- Must be comfortable with rapid iteration and frequent context switching
- High expectations for both speed and quality
- You prefer writing specs and handing off over getting hands-on with data, prototypes, and AI tools
- Must navigate complex organizational dynamics

Why beehiiv?

Our values aren't a poster on the wall — they're the bar. It’s how we operate, publicly and privately, and what we should return to when making decisions. That’s how we keep our team momentum. That’s how we hire and keep A players.

beehiiv’s values:

1. There's no room for B players ⭐: the best makes everyone better.
2. Maniacal sense of urgency ⚡: speed is our superpower.
3. Say what you think with positive intent : disagree openly and give hard feedback directly, with the intent to help someone improve.
4. User-obsessed : every decision starts with one question: how does this add value for the user?
5. Ego comes second, winning comes first : we're here to create the best outcome; the team comes before the individual.

We'll take care of you:

- Competitive salary
- Stock options
- Health, dental, and vision Insurance
- 401(k) employer match
- Unlimited PTO (mandatory 10 days per year minimum)
- Annual in-person team offsite
- Unlimited book budget
- Monthly Wellness Days (every third Friday of the month)

**About Versapay**

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

## Your Impact at Versapay:

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway, you will own Versapay’s payment gateways: the platform every Versapay payment flows through, from authorization to settlement.

You will set the vision and roadmap for a modular, scalable, multi-tenant gateway that connects Versapay’s accounts receivable products to processors, acquirers, and card & bank networks. You own both the product and business outcomes for the gateways; authorization and payment success rates, uptime and latency, downgrades, cost per transaction, and more.

This is a platform role. Your customers are Versapay’s product teams, our core processing partners, the developers and ERP partners who integrate with us, and the ledger and finance teams who depend on every payment landing correctly. You will partner directly with engineering on architecture and delivery, work with go-to-market teams on positioning and regularly represent gateway strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment.

This is an opportunity for a product leader who has built/scaled a payment gateway and is ready to grow and modernize a global B2B payments platform.

\\n **What You'll Do:**

- Own the gateway strategy and roadmap. Set the multi-year vision for Versapay’s owned gateways across card, bank, and alternative payment methods in every market we serve. Balance near-term improvements with long-term platform investments and make the trade-offs explicit.


- Drive payment performance. Own the gateway’s core KPIs: authorization and payment success rates, decline and retry performance, uptime, latency, and processing cost. Improve them through connection optimization, failover, smart retries, network tokenization, account updater, 3DS and authentication flows, and B2B card data (Level 2/3).


- Build the platform others build on. Define the gateway’s APIs, SDKs, hosted payment pages, webhooks, and merchant and MID configuration so Versapay product teams and partners can launch new payment experiences in days, not quarters.


- Own processor, acquirer, and network connectivity. Lead the evaluation, certification, and launch of processor and acquirer integrations and new network capabilities. Translate network specs and mandates into clear requirements, and keep the gateway compliant with card brand rules, PCI DSS, and regional regulations.


- Own the transaction lifecycle end to end. Authorization, capture, refunds, voids, disputes and chargebacks, and settlement, including the clean handoff of transaction data to ledger and reconciliation. Partner with risk, compliance, and payment operations to keep money moving safely.


- Lead engineering teams to deliver. Lead engineering team(s) and oversee execution across pods, from writing requirements to measuring success. Drive trade-off decisions on architecture, reliability, and platform design while keeping the team unblocked and managing the SDLC.


- Use AI to compound platform value. Apply ML and agentic approaches to retry optimization, decline analysis, anomaly detection, incident triage, and partner integration support. Versapay is rebuilding for an AI-native operating model, and the gateway is core to that.


- Be the in-house expert. Serve as Versapay’s authority on gateway architecture, payment processing, and network rules. Educate product and engineering teams, brief executives, and represent the platform externally with partners and customers.


**What You Bring to the Team:**

- 6+ years in payments or fintech product management, with at least 3 years owning a payment gateway, processing, orchestration, or PSP platform end to end. Senior IC who has driven a roadmap, not just contributed to one.


- Built or significantly scaled a gateway. You have shipped gateway capabilities in production — not just integrated a third-party gateway — and can speak to what changed and why.


- Deep transaction lifecycle expertise. You understand authorization flows, network messaging (ISO 8583), tokenization, capture and settlement, chargebacks, interchange, and failover, and how each affects merchants and cost.


- A record of moving payment performance metrics. You have measurably improved authorization rates, processing cost, uptime, or latency, and can show the data.


- Global payments expertise. Experience across North America and international markets, including multi-currency processing, local payment methods, and the regimes that govern them (PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, card brand rules).


- Track record of leading engineering teams in execution. You have overseen engineering pods or squads as the product owner, setting priorities, removing blockers, making architectural trade-offs alongside engineering leadership, and shipping on commitment.


- AI fluency. Hands-on experience applying LLMs, ML, or agentic systems to payment workflows. You have a clear, defensible point of view on where AI belongs in a gateway and where it must not.


- Builder mentality. Entrepreneurial, biased to action, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by net-new initiatives where the path is not yet drawn.

$160,000 - $180,000 a year

**Join the Force Behind Law Enforcement Success**

At LeadsOnline, we bridge the gap between technology and justice, empowering law enforcement agencies with cutting-edge solutions to close cases and serve their communities. Production Test Technicians play a critical role in our mission, connecting law enforcement agencies with our powerful tools to help them work smarter and faster. Everything we do is grounded in our core values of **Service, Energy, Ownership,** and **People**—and we’re looking for someone who embodies these principles.

As a **Senior Product Manager** , you'll own the vision and execution for our Ballistics product line one of our most strategically important offerings. You'll sit at the intersection of customer need, technical possibility, and business impact, working across engineering, marketing, and operations on products that genuinely matter.

**What You'll Do**

- **Set the vision.** Define and maintain a compelling product roadmap that aligns long-term strategy with near-term delivery across our Ballistics products.
- **Lead with data.** Build and track the metrics that tell you whether your products are healthy and act decisively when they aren't.

- Experience working in or alongside Agile development teams

## **Senior Product Manager, Payments**

## **About** **Super.com**

We started Super.com to help maximize lives–both the lives of our customers and the lives of our team – so that everyone can experience all that life has to offer. For our employees, our promise is that Super.com is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to unlock one’s potential, where learning is celebrated and impact is realized.

We are more than a fast-paced, high-growth tech company; we care about our people and take career progression seriously. This is your career and our aim is to supercharge it through the people, the work, and the programs that fuel who we are.

## **About the role**

Payments at Super.com spans two business models with different mechanics. Our travel business runs high-value one-time transactions with authorization holds, delayed capture, and cancellation driven disputes. Our subscription business runs recurring billing, where retry logic, credential lifecycle, and involuntary churn drive the numbers. You will own both.

This is an individual contributor role. You will be the lead of the payments MAT (mission-aligned team): running the team’s planning and day-to-day execution against the payments roadmap, and leading it through clarity, credibility, and influence rather than reporting lines.

The role will report to the Director of Product and work closely with the Head of Payments, who sets the overall payments strategy and roadmap. Fraud prevention sits with a separate department, and disputes sits with a dedicated disputes function. You will partner with both, as routing, authorization rate, and 3DS decisions cut across all three.

## **About the team**

This role sits on the Product team at Super.com. We operate as a cross-functional, mission-aligned team (MAT), partnering with engineering, product, data, and commercial leaders to provide best in class payments experiences to our customers and partners, while increasing the likelihood of positive, profitable transactions. The MAT is made up primarily of engineers, along with a technical account manager.

## **What you’ll be working on:**

- **Contribute to the payments roadmap.** Work with the Head of Payments on the roadmap for your area, and own prioritization of the MAT’s backlog within it. Bring data-backed recommendations when you see an opportunity to change course.

- **Write the requirements.** PRDs and business requirements that engineers can build from, covering failure paths, reconciliation impact, and explicit scope boundaries.

- **Lead the payments MAT day to day.** Run the team’s planning and rituals, keep the backlog prioritized against the roadmap, and be the team’s main point of contact for stakeholders. Partner with the engineering manager, who owns engineering execution and the engineers themselves.

- **Drive delivery.** Sequence work, remove blockers, and manage scope within the agreed roadmap, escalating tradeoffs that change priorities or timelines to the Head of Payments.

- **Improve routing and authorization performance.** Run routing and retry experiments, evaluate the results, and recommend changes.

- **Support payments market entry** as we expand internationally, researching local payment method coverage and writing requirements for new-market launches, in partnership with the Head of Payments.

- **Use data to recommend improvements.** Analyze authorization rates, decline patterns, cost per transaction, and settlement performance, and bring recommendations to the team and the Head of Payments.

- **Contribute to monthly payments reporting** for Finance, covering delivery, performance against targets, and upcoming priorities.

- **Track industry and regulatory change** (e.g., SCA, network rules, APM adoption) and flag its impact on your roadmap.


## **What we’re looking for:**

- 5+ years of experience in Product Management, including 1+ year working on payments, fintech, checkout, or billing products.

- Working knowledge of a modern payments stack, including gateways, processors and acquirers, tokenization, and alternative payment methods.

- Understanding of one-time payment mechanics (authorization holds, delayed capture, settlement) or recurring billing mechanics (dunning, retries, credential-on-file), with curiosity to learn the other.

- A track record of shipping. You have shipped features end to end with engineering, from requirements through launch.

- Product craft. You write clear requirements, you can explain the reasoning behind a prioritization decision, and you are disciplined about scope.

- Technical and data fluency sufficient to work closely with engineers, understand technical tradeoffs, and analyze performance data.

- Comfortable coordinating a cross-functional team and keeping work moving without formal authority, and knowing when to escalate.

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can communicate clearly with engineers and stakeholders.

- Resourceful and self-directed. You can manage shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.


## **Bonus points for:**

- Exposure to payments launches in new markets, particularly in APAC, EEA or LATAM.

- Experience in high-volume consumer businesses, and familiarity with marketplace, travel, or e-commerce payment flows.

- Exposure to disputes and chargeback data.


## **We’ve got you covered:**

At Super.com, we believe in supporting our team so they can thrive—both at work and in life.

- Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world and choose the hours that suit you best. We trust you to get great work done on your terms.

- Time to Recharge: Enjoy unlimited PTO, company-wide recharge days, and annual team offsites.

- Everyday Perks: Weekly UberEats credits and travel discounts on SuperTravel help you enjoy the little things.

- Family-Friendly Benefits: We support growing families with generous parental leave and a flexible return-to-work plan.

- Comprehensive Compensation: Competitive salary, equity options, annual bonus, retirement matching, and top-tier benefits packages.

- Investing in You: Access to wellness budgets, personal development funds, and team-level learning resources.

Full-time

Canals

## **About Canals** Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI. Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows. We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 140 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.

## **The Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help us launch and scale new products.

We need someone obsessed with UX clarity; someone who thinks deeply about user behavior, flow, and comprehension. Your job is to make sure there is no ambiguity in how the product is used. Every button, every screen, every flow should be unbreakable and self-evident, even to users who aren't tech-savvy.

You should be the kind of PM who gets joy from anticipating user confusion and eliminating it. Who sees a subtle UX flaw and can’t rest until it’s fixed. Who builds clean, elegant product experiences that guide users to success without needing training or guesswork.

## **What You’ll Do**

- Work directly with the co-founder, CEO to define, refine, and own product direction

- Develop intuitive product flows that reduce cognitive load and eliminate user error

- Collaborate closely with design and engineering to ensure UX is seamless and intentional

- Prioritize simplicity and clarity in every decision, from language to layout

- Deeply understand user behavior and spot points of friction before they cause problems

- Turn high-level goals into clearly defined, well-scoped product specs and flows

- Fight for great UX and customer empathy at every stage of development

- Own the product roadmap and ensure consistent progress on core product quality


## **What You'll Bring**

- Typically, 7+ years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS

- Track record of shipping clean, simple, high-clarity user experiences

- Deep intuition for UX and user behavior - you anticipate where users get confused

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to give and receive direct feedback

- Able to work independently with high ownership and initiative

- Experience working with early-stage teams or fast-paced startups


## Why Join Canals

We're building software that solves real problems for an industry that keeps the world running. Our customers rely on our platform every day to operate their businesses.

We've found strong product-market fit and continue to grow quickly, creating opportunities for people who want to have a meaningful impact on the trajectory of a company.

We believe great people build great companies. That's why we invest heavily in hiring, development, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.

You'll work alongside ambitious, thoughtful teammates who care deeply about what they do, challenge each other directly, and have a lot of fun along the way.

We value ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and people are trusted to make things happen.

We're remote-first, flexible, and distributed across North and South America, bringing together talented people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

##### Clipboard Product Manager Opportunity

Clipboard is a Sequoia-backed marketplace connecting nurses and healthcare professionals with long-term care facilities, with over $800M in annual transactions. We're hiring Senior Product Managers to own core domains of the marketplace. Think pricing, matching, reliability, facility onboarding; all the systems the business runs on!

You'll be running a domain where the right answer changes as the marketplace changes, and where your mental model and prioritization are the single most valuable artifact your team has. You will:

- Build the mental model. Grounded in customer conversations, support tickets, Salesforce, and our own data.
- Pick the metrics. The ones that tell you and the org whether you're serving that customer well. When the right metric doesn't exist, you say so and propose the best proxy, limitations stated.
- Steward the improvements. Research, experiments, core flow changes, technical investments. An excellent PM here doesn't just move metrics, they make prioritization calls that compound.

All of this gets written down and shared constantly. A one-page mental model your team can reference without you in the room. A monthly check-in. Enough visibility that engineers make autonomous decisions and leadership can push back at "is this the right bet" rather than "what's the bet." You'll work alongside an Applied Science team that owns the quantitative infrastructure your domain depends on: pricing algorithms, causal models, experiment frameworks.

Minimum requirements include:

- 2+ years of product management, with experience in marketplaces preferred
- You can query data yourself (SQL or equivalent)
- You've shipped meaningful features on a small, fast-moving team
- You write clearly and often
- Ability to work 2-3 days per week out of either our NYC or San Francisco office

Who thrives here:

- Extreme ownership: the buck stops with you regardless of what anyone else did or didn't do.
- Extreme curiosity: you ask "why" five times on the same problem before you're satisfied.
- You hold a clear point of view and update it visibly when the data disagrees.
- Background in marketplace product, ops research, or operating roles at fast-scaling startups is a strong signal.

Our values live here. If this sounds like a team you want to be on, apply!

Quick note on scammers: Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

# Senior Product Manager

The Art of Education

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4067137836958558501?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6346955277524587237&crId=US_0US_0)

**Who You Are**

You're a product leader who owns an entire product area (outcomes, priorities, strategic direction, and the hard tradeoffs between competing bets), and you're able to hold it all as one coherent whole rather than a stack of disconnected features. You translate where the company is going into where the product is going, and you can tell the difference between a roadmap that looks impressive and one that genuinely moves the needle for educators. When the path is ambiguous, you're the one who creates clarity.

You're energized by AOE's mission to grow amazing teachers, and you never lose sight of the classroom on the other end of a product decision. You do your best work in a fully remote environment built on clarity, evidence, and earned trust. You lead through influence and product judgment (not consensus or headcount) by staying hands-on with engineers, designers, and fellow PMs to define the work, while keeping every workstream laddering up to a cohesive direction.

**What You'll Do**

As our **Senior Product Manager** , you'll own a full product area end-to-end and be the single accountable owner for its outcomes. You'll align product-area strategy to our broader company priorities, keep the whole area coherent, and partner across squads to deliver measurable value to art educators. You'll drive product direction in partnership with the Product team while staying close enough to the work to define it.

Every day will look a little different, but in general, you'll:

- **Own Your Product-Area:** You'll be the single, accountable owner for outcomes across your area, defining success metrics such as engagement, retention, and learning impact, and influencing prioritization calls among competing opportunities.
- **Set Product-Area Strategy:** You'll translate company strategy into a clear product-area strategy, priorities, and success measures, and ensure scoped workstreams ladder up to a single coherent direction rather than drifting apart.
- **Own Discovery Quality Across Your Area:** You'll lead discovery directly through regular educator engagement, and you'll be accountable for the quality and consistency of discovery across every squad in your area, never delegating it away.
- **Resolve the Hard Tradeoffs:** You'll make and defend the calls across related problem spaces, user needs, and investments, resolving cross-scope conflicts and escalating only genuine portfolio-level tradeoffs to Product leadership.
- **Be Hands-On With the Work:** You'll define product-area Epics and work directly with engineering to break them into coherent, incremental slices, and write and refine User Stories with clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and learning-quality requirements.
- **Align the Around the Product:** You'll bring stakeholders across the org onto the same priorities and direction, and keep cross-functional alignment strong without drowning the work in coordination overhead.
- **Drive Outcomes and Experimentation:** You'll track performance against the outcomes you defined, use data and AI-assisted analysis to evaluate impact, and drive experimentation that compounds into better decisions over time.

**What You've Done Before**

You have a successful track record of at least 5 years of owning a product or product area with measurable outcomes (not just contributed to one), and you're excited to share the direction you set and the results it drove.

You bring strong discovery skills and genuine comfort with engaging users directly; you make and defend product decisions with evidence and judgment rather than consensus; and you've worked hands-on across design, engineering, and domain experts, such as curriculum.

You're at your best operating in ambiguity and turning it into clarity, and you can hold the big-picture strategy and the epic-and-story-level detail at the same time, because in this role you'll do both.

**It'd Be Great If You've Done This**

If you've led a product area in education, ed-tech, or another mission-driven space where learning impact was the real measure of success, you'll fit right in.

Experience setting strategy across multiple squads or workstreams, partnering closely with curriculum or subject-matter experts, using AI to sharpen discovery and decision-making, and building for both individual educators and institutional customers, such as schools and districts, will all move you toward the top of the list. And if the classroom on the other end of the roadmap is what motivates you, that's exactly the instinct we're looking for.

# Senior Product Manager

$150k - $215k

Full-time

Viz.ai
