## **About Viz.ai** Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the \#1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.

### **The Role**

We're looking for a pulmonologist who wants to build better tools for pulmonary care. In this Senior Product Manager role, you'll use your firsthand clinical experience to own one or more care pathways in our Pulmonary suite—from understanding the problem in clinic to testing solutions with clinicians and bringing them into use.

The focus starts with COPD, AATD, and broader pulmonary clinic workflows, including asthma, within a portfolio that also includes incidental pulmonary nodules and lung cancer screening. Some of this work is live with customers; some is still being built and validated.

We welcome pulmonologists moving from clinical practice into product, as well as those already working in product management or digital health. You do not need to have held a product management title. What matters is firsthand knowledge of pulmonary care and a track record of improving clinical workflows, implementing clinical software, or leading digital health initiatives.

Reporting to the Pulmonary product leader, you'll own your pathways end to end: defining customer problems, setting priorities and roadmap, developing requirements, setting success measures, and driving the work through launch and adoption. You'll partner with our Clinical team and CMO so decisions are clinically sound and evidence-informed. This is a hands-on product ownership role, not a clinical advisory position.

### **What You'll Do**

- Own one or more pulmonary care pathways end to end, translating guidelines and evidence into patient criteria, care gap logic, and workflow design.

- Lead discovery and site visits with pulmonary care teams and KOLs, and turn what you learn into prioritized problems and recommendations.

- Develop requirements with our product and engineering teams, set success measures, and drive cross-functional follow-through, surfacing dependencies and blockers early.

- Stay with products after go-live: identify barriers to use, partner with Customer Success, Implementation, Design, and Engineering to fix them, and use feedback and usage data to guide improvements.

- Lead clinical investigation and resolution of customer issues alongside our customer-facing teams, and partner with Clinical and the CMO on claims, validation, and evidence.

- Prototype and test ideas with clinicians using design and AI-assisted prototyping tools.


### **Qualifications**

- MD/DO with completed specialty training in pulmonary medicine and medical licensure, active or previously held.

- 3+ years of clinical practice in pulmonary medicine. Outpatient pulmonary experience is strongly preferred, including longitudinal COPD and asthma management, testing, referrals, follow-up, and care-team coordination.

- Product management or digital health experience, or a track record of improving clinical workflows, implementing clinical software, or leading digital health initiatives. 2+ years of relevant experience preferred.

- Structured problem-solving, clear writing, and a record of driving work to completion across teams.

- Working knowledge of pulmonary guidelines and how care pathways run inside health systems.

- Familiarity with EHR workflows - Epic experience preferred

- Curiosity about AI products and willingness to prototype and test ideas yourself.


### **Bonus Qualifications**

- Experience running a COPD, asthma, or AATD program, or an incidental nodule or lung cancer screening program.

- Experience with clinical AI validation or FDA CDS guidance.

- Experience with pharma or life sciences partners in respiratory disease.


### **How We Think About Product**

Great healthcare products start with the patient and succeed by understanding the people who deliver their care. Clinical credibility earns a product its first use; follow-through keeps it in use. We want someone who knows respiratory care from practice and stays with a product until it works in the clinic. Above all, you should be motivated by our mission to increase access to lifesaving treatments and improve care for people with respiratory disease.

## **Why should you join us?**

- If you are looking to make an impact, we are mission-driven and are making a difference in peoples’ lives every day.

- If you want to be a part of an amazing team , our people are the heart of everything we do.

- If you are a self-starter and naturally motivated, our work is driven by curiosity, innovation and team collaboration which allows us to leverage our skills immeasurably.


We are a remote-first company across the U.S. and EU, with a team in Tel Aviv operating in a flexible hybrid model, conveniently located near a train line.

Viz.ai is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided.

In the U.S., Viz offers competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), generous vacation, and additional benefits to full-time employees. Viz.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law.

Employees in Israel are offered a comprehensive benefits package, including, among others: dental insurance, performance-based bonuses, a Cibus meal allowance, meals at the office, and more.

If you’re applying for a position in San Francisco, please review the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance guidelines applicable in your area.

Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our white label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.

As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.

As a Senior Product Manager at Array you will be a foundational member of a team, building on the backbone of our products. You will be working directly with leadership to define product strategy internally and externally, strategizing from a technical standpoint, how to ensure our products continue to be successful and dynamic. We are particularly interested in optimizing and understanding consumer front end conversion rates. You will work alongside product managers, engineers, and operational teams while building products that internal and external customers love.

Selected candidates will have the opportunity to participate in a month to month evaluation period, typically lasting between 3-6 months. During this period, you will be expected to work on complex tasks with some ambiguity, utilize AI tools to enhance efficiency, and collaborate with the CEO, demonstrate technical ability with AI and SQL/data analysis. During the evaluation period, we will determine whether to transition to full-time employment, extend the contract, or conclude the engagement.

**You Will:**

- Own and optimize the front-end experience of the product, with a focus on increasing conversion rates and user engagement.
- Drive improvements in user onboarding and application flows, ensuring the best possible experience for customers.
- Analyze user feedback and data to make informed decisions that enhance product performance and drive higher conversion.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between business needs, user expectations, and product goals.
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve customer acquisition and retention, focusing on organic growth and return on spend.
- Build a cohesive strategy to optimize the B2B2C product journey, maximizing the effectiveness of both business and consumer touchpoints.
- Partner with other Product Managers and engineering teams to develop a compelling vision, strategy, and roadmap.
- Work with product and engineering to clarify, triage, and prioritize bugs.
- Assess risk and come up with well thought out solutions to eliminate any roadblocks for the team in accomplishing tasks on the product roadmap.
- Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it's your default, not an afterthought.

**You Have:**

- 6+ years of experience in a technically focused product management role; experience building products that shipped to market.
- Strong technical background: Computer Science or software engineering experience would be great; must have experience writing in SQL and synthesizing data on your own.
- Experience managing a consumer-facing app or product, with a focus on front-end conversion rate optimization.
- Proven ability to grow key user metrics (e.g., users, monthly active users) through specific initiatives related to onboarding or user flow.
- Expertise in managing product experiences for D2C or B2B2C models, with a focus on improving user-facing interactions.
- Familiarity with identifying and addressing barriers to conversion and making data-driven decisions to boost performance.
- Ability to understand and navigate B2B2C complexities, balancing the needs of both business partners and end users.
- Strong understanding of consumer company metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, and ROI, with experience avoiding excessive reliance on paid ad spend.
- A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.

**Pay Transparency:** $80/hr-$100/hr, 40 hours per week -- for the contract period.

- 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting
- Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents
- $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set-up your unique remote office
- $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses
- Summer Fridays (half-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August

# Senior Product Manager

$180k - $200k

Full-time

RapidAI

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5103722880211517812?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=234&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4788784046499978098&crId=US_0US_0)

RapidAI is the trusted leader in deep clinical AI, helping hospitals deliver faster, more informed care through intelligent imaging and integrated workflows. The Rapid Enterprise™ Platform supports disease states across the care spectrum, but it’s our clinical depth that drives the most meaningful impact — improving decision-making, patient outcomes, and health-system performance. Used by more than 2,500 hospitals in over 100 countries and backed by 700+ clinical studies, including research that helped expand national stroke-treatment guidelines, RapidAI is the most clinically validated AI platform in healthcare.

You will own RapidAI’s mobile and web apps: the apps that stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic, and other acute-care teams use to receive AI triage notifications, review imaging, and coordinate care when minutes matter. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You decide what the apps do and why, write the requirements engineering builds from, and stay with each release until it has changed how clinicians work. Clinical product managers own the AI modules; you own how clinicians receive their results and act on them. Commercial strategy and business development sit with other teams.

Our product team works AI-first. We build and use our own AI agents for discovery, requirements, and release work, and we prototype before we specify. When building gets cheap, the hard part of product management is deciding what is worth building and learning quickly whether it worked. We are looking for someone who thrives in that environment, wants to push it further, and knows that at a medical device company, moving faster never means lowering the bar for patient safety.

\\n **How you help us grow!**

Position Duties and responsibilities:

- **Own the outcome:** Set the direction, roadmap, and priorities for the apps. When building is cheap, deciding what not to build matters more, not less: say no to good ideas that are not the most important thing. Tie each initiative to a result you can measure, such as time from scan to care-team notification or adoption across a health system’s sites, and report what actually happened after it shipped.
- **Know the workflow first-hand:** Spend regular time with the people who use the apps (neurologists, radiologists, emergency physicians, stroke and PE coordinators, nurses) and in the workflows around them: stroke codes, PE response team activations, transfers between hospitals. Turn what you see into clear problem statements.
- **Prototype before you specify:** Build working prototypes yourself with AI coding and design tools, put them in front of clinicians within days, and bring evidence rather than a document to the decision to commit engineering time.
- **Write requirements engineering can build from:** Write your own epics and user stories, with testable acceptance criteria, edge cases, error states, and analytics events. Use AI to draft, challenge, and check them, and own every word: at a medical device company, requirements are design inputs that must be unambiguous, verifiable, and traceable to user needs and risk controls. If a coding agent cannot build from a spec, the spec is not finished.
- **Bring AI to clinicians’ problems:** Beyond the imaging AI modules, find where language models and agents can take work off a care team’s plate, such as pulling the right context from the EHR, drafting documentation, or getting the right information to the right person. Define what good looks like before building, in evals as well as acceptance criteria, and design for the moments the model is wrong.
- **Treat notification reliability as patient safety:** A late or missed notification can delay treatment, and too many notifications teach clinicians to ignore them. Own notification behavior, thresholds, and settings with both risks in mind, and partner with Platform and Engineering on delivery, monitoring, and supportability.
- **Turn repeated work into reusable patterns:** Every new AI module, including partner algorithms, reaches clinicians through the same building blocks: notifications, patient list cards, case summaries, the status feed, and settings. Define and maintain these as patterns so that bringing the next module to the apps is configuration, not a project.
- **Ship safely in a regulated environment:** Work within our design-control process alongside Quality, Regulatory, and Clinical: contribute to risk analysis and usability engineering, support verification and validation, and own release readiness for your area. Move fast where it is safe (discovery, prototyping, analysis) and hold the line where it matters (design inputs, risk controls, verification, protected health information). Recognize which changes need a regulatory assessment, and raise them early.
- **Work as one team with Design and Engineering:** Be in the problem with designers and engineers from the start, and stay available for the many small decisions that come up mid-sprint, including across time zones. Expect roles to overlap: you will build, and designers and engineers will make product calls.
- **Communicate decisions in writing:** Share progress as working demos where you can, and write roadmap updates, decision records, and release notes that executives and clinical, sales, and support teams can act on. Bring product expertise to key customer conversations, and equip product marketing and customer success with what shipped and why it matters; positioning and sales materials belong to product marketing.
- **Push the team’s AI practice forward:** Improve the agents and workflows the product team runs on, automate your own repetitive work, share what works, and mentor other product managers by example.

**What you bring!**

**Required**

- 5+ years of software product management experience, including ownership of a mobile or web product that professionals rely on in their daily work.
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, life sciences, nursing or another health profession, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- AI built into daily work: uses AI through repeatable workflows, not one-off prompts, for research synthesis, requirements, analysis, and prototyping, and can show how it changed the speed or quality of the work. Trajectory matters as much as current skill: what was tried, kept, and dropped.
- Hands-on building: has built working prototypes or tools with AI coding tools and used them to test ideas with real users.
- Product judgment and taste: when building is cheap, choosing what to build is the job. Prioritizes with incomplete information, states assumptions, and changes course when the evidence does.
- A record of writing requirements that engineers build from directly: precise, testable, and complete on edge cases.
- Depth in mobile products: iOS and Android conventions; how push notifications are delivered and where delivery fails (OS settings, Focus and Do Not Disturb, critical alerts); behavior on poor connectivity; and release mechanics (app store review, staged rollout, users on old versions).
- Technical fluency to discuss APIs, data models, and system design with engineers, and to work through trade-offs with them rather than hand problems over.
- Clear, concise writing, and the ability to explain the same decision to a clinician, an engineer, and an executive.
- Ownership: follows a problem across team boundaries until it is solved, and owns AI-assisted work as fully as any other: defines what good looks like up front, checks output critically, and catches errors before they reach anyone else.

**Preferred**

- Experience building for clinicians, particularly in acute care (stroke, emergency medicine, critical care, radiology), or a clinical background such as nursing.
- Experience shipping software as a medical device or in another regulated environment; working knowledge of FDA design controls, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and IEC 62366.
- Experience shipping AI-powered features: writing evals, judging model output quality, and designing for when the model is wrong.
- Has built agents, automations, or skills that other people use in their daily work.
- Experience with real-time messaging, alerting, or care-team communication products.
- Familiarity with healthcare data and interoperability: DICOM, HL7, FHIR, and HIPAA.
- Product analytics experience: event instrumentation, funnels, and cohort analysis.

$150k - $200k

Full-time

Playlab

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5502353780207697622?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=426&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1112445311557172937&crId=US_0US_0)

## **About Playlab** Playlab is a tech non-profit dedicated to helping educators and students become critical consumers and creators of AI. We believe that an open-source, community-driven approach is key to harnessing the potential of AI in education. AI is a new design material and should be shaped by many to bring their ideas about learning to life. We equip communities with software and hands-on learning that empowers educators & students to build AI apps for their unique context. If you're passionate about building creative, equitable futures for students and teachers, we hope you'll join us.

## **The Role**

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who wants to shape how educators and students build with AI.

Your product work will:

- **Expand what's possible:** Add new capabilities (e.g., components, agents) that expands how creators craft ai native software for their contexts.

- **Deepen the context:** Build on our current work on curriculum knowledge graphs and organizational knowledge bases to deepen how creators can leverage their context.

- **Set the safety standard:** Push the boundaries on what responsible and safe AI in education looks like. This includes advancing our moderation and safety systems; supporting learnability, legibility, and interpretability within the product; collaborating with key ecosystem partners; and open sourcing as much of this work as we can to advance the ecosystem.


You'll work directly with our CTO, engineering team, ML team, designers, and partnerships team. You'll hear directly from educators through our deep partner relationships. And you'll make product decisions that affect how educators and learners across the globe experience AI in education.

This role requires comfort with ambiguity. Playlab is an early-stage product with significant scope, a growing team, and limited existing product process. You'll need to build that process as you go and not wait for someone to hand it to you. If you need a lot of structure to do your best work, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive when you can shape the environment around you, read on.

## **What You'll Do**

**Drive Product Execution**

- Prioritize ruthlessly, write clear specs, and work with design, engineering, and learning teams to ship

- De-risk builds by breaking work into meaningful increments that let us learn as we go

- Make tradeoffs when scope, timeline, and resources collide and communicate those tradeoffs clearly


**Go Deep on the Details**

- Write detailed requirements that align design, engineering, and go-to-market teams

- Understand the technical constraints and possibilities, and work side-by-side with engineering

- Engage directly with users, and gather user feedback, usage data, and partner insights to inform decisions


**Build Product Process**

- Establish rituals, artifacts, and communication patterns that help a growing team stay aligned

- Create clarity about how product decisions get made, without slowing the team down

- Document what's working so others can build on it


**Collaborate Across Teams**

- Work with Learning and Partnerships to translate field feedback into clear priorities and simpler designs

- Coordinate with design to ensure what we build is usable, not just functional


**Refine Strategy as You Learn**

- Pressure-test strategic assumptions against what you see in the product and hear from users

- Surface when priorities should shift, and make the case with evidence

- Help leadership make better decisions by bringing clarity to ambiguous situations


## **You Might Be a Fit If You...**

- Have 7+ years of product management experience, including at least one early-stage or high-growth environment where you had to build process, not just follow it

- Have led product development for AI-powered or technically complex products—you can work fluently with ML and engineering teams

- Get energy from the details: you'd rather write a clear spec than a strategy deck

- Ship fast without cutting corners: you know how to de-risk builds and make incremental progress

- Thrive in ambiguity and can make good decisions with incomplete information

- Communicate crisply: you can explain complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences

- Care about education, equity, or mission-driven work; this isn't just a job, it's a chance to shape how AI shows up in schools


## **Bonus Points For...**

- Experience in edtech or deep familiarity with how products land in K-12 or higher ed environments

- Background working on platforms or tools where users build things (not just consume content)

- Experience with responsible AI, content moderation, or trust & safety product work

- Deep familiarity with the AI/LLM product landscape


## **Why Join Us?**

**Build the Product Function:** You'll be Playlab's first PM and will get the chance to shape how product management works here.

**Meaningful Scope:** You'll own strategic pillars that directly affect whether educators can build AI tools that transform their classrooms.

**Mission-Aligned Team:** Join a small, passionate group committed to equity, creativity, and joyful learning.

**Direct User Connection:** Playlab's deep partnerships mean you'll hear directly from educators

**Flexible Work:** Remote-first environment with autonomy and a strong culture of collaboration. Occasional travel for partner meetings and team gatherings.

**Competitive Pay & Benefits:** Includes salary, healthcare, retirement, generous time off, and opportunities for professional growth.

$185k - $215k

Full-time

Arbital Health

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2807573782182284677?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=450&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6146447297411868750&crId=US_0US_0)

Arbital Health is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and actuarial leader that centralizes, measures, and adjudicates value-based care contracts at scale. We enable payers and providers to design, measure, and execute value-based agreements with greater transparency, efficiency, and financial predictability.

We invest in hiring high potential and humble individuals who thrive in fast-paced environments and can rapidly grow their responsibilities as we continue to accelerate our growth.

We were co-founded by Brian Overstreet and Travis May (founder & former CEO of LiveRamp and Datavant, the two biggest data companies of the last 20 years), and are backed by Transformation Capital, Valtruis and other leading investors. In our first 2 years, Arbital Health has established itself as a trusted partner for over 40 payers, providers, and other stakeholders looking to navigate the complexities of risk-based contracting.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the product area that measures, settles, and projects the financial performance of value-based care contracts for payers and providers. You will also own the core app experience including home pages, navigation, notifications, access and permissions. You will work with engineers, actuaries, and clients to set priorities, write requirements, and ship features. This role needs a strong product manager who knows how to build for different types of users and can learn how value-based care contracts work. You don't need to be an actuary. Our actuaries own the calculation methodology, and you will work with them on contract and calculation details.

\\n **Responsibilities:**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

• Own the roadmap for Contract Financials and the app shell (home pages, navigation, notifications, etc.), including how their data and results are used across the platform and in AI features

• Prioritize work across client needs, contract requirements, and platform improvements, and document the tradeoffs

• Turn individual client and contract requirements into configurable product capabilities that work across many clients

• Own access and tenancy, including organizations, roles and permissions, line-of-business and segment scoping, SSO, and audit logs

• Use product usage data to see how each persona uses the platform, where they get stuck, and what to build next

**Execution & Delivery**

• Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria, including the calculation rules each feature must follow

• Scope new feature requirements by comparing a new contract’s terms with the contract structures the platform already supports

• Plan testing with actuaries before release, and see each feature through launch and documentation

• Triage bugs and requests, set priority, and follow each through to resolution

**Contract & Technical Depth**

• Be the product expert on Contract Financials capabilities and adjacent functions, and on how value-based care contracts are measured and settled

• Review contract terms with actuaries as needed to identify requirements the product does not yet support

• Work hands-on with data: run SQL queries, review outputs, and check calculations against source data

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

• Work closely with engineering and actuarial teams on requirements, methodology, and testing

• Work with the other product teams on shared areas like Arbital AI chat, accessibility, and security

• Work with Sales and client-facing teams to understand market needs and buyer priorities, and use that input to set the roadmap

• Educate internal teams on existing product capabilities, and decide whether to build support for contract terms the platform does not handle yet

• Communicate roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery status to internal teams and clients

**Ownership & Communication**

• Act as the main product contact for Contract Financials questions and requests

• Write release notes and product updates for internal teams and clients

**Requirements:**

• 5+ years of experience in product management, actuarial, analytics, or a similar role, with at least 3 years as a product manager on B2B data, analytics, or financial software products

• Some familiarity with value-based care contracts (shared savings, capitation, MLR, benchmarks and targets, attribution, risk sharing, reconciliation and settlement), and the interest to go deeper with our actuaries

• Track record of owning a product area end to end, from discovery through release and adoption

• Experience building scalable SaaS or platform products used by many customers, including turning recurring customer requests into general capabilities

• Experience owning core product experience, such as home pages, navigation, notifications, personalization, or roles and permissions in a multi-tenant product

• Experience using AI tools in daily product work, such as drafting PRDs and user stories, prototyping features, analyzing data and customer feedback, and writing queries

• Experience shipping AI features in a product, such as an in-app assistant or chat

• Experience using product analytics and user research to decide what to build

• Ability to turn complex business rules into clear, buildable requirements, working with experts like actuaries

• Comfortable reading data schemas, writing SQL

• Experience working with clients or client-facing teams

• Experience with healthcare data such as claims, eligibility, revenue, and risk scores

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to tailor messaging to actuaries, engineers, and business audiences

• High attention to detail and a strong bias toward accuracy in financial calculations

• Comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

**Nice to Have:**

• Experience in payer or provider contract operations, VBC finance, or settlement reconciliation

• Experience with Medicare Advantage, ACO REACH, MSSP, Medicaid, or Commercial value-based contracts

• Prior work at a health tech startup or data-driven healthcare company

• Experience with R, Python or similar analysis tools

\\n

$185,000 - $215,000 a year

\\n

**Why Join Us?**

We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change healthcare. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member.

**We Offer:**

• Generous equity grants of ISO stock options

• We offer an exceptional benefits package with high employer-paid contributions for health, dental, and vision insurance

• 4% 401(k) match

• Flexible PTO, a weeklong winter shutdown, and 10 holidays each year

• Occasional travel required - Quarterly team offsites

• The opportunity to build a critical software platform that accelerates the American healthcare system's transition to value-based care

**Work Authorization**

• Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for the duration of their employment.

• This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. • Applicants must be able to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsorship.

The Amherst Group's companies are comprised of leading real estate investment and advisory firms with a mission to transform the way real estate is owned, financed and managed. Amherst leverages its proprietary data, analytics, technology, and decades of experience to seek solutions for a fragmented, slow-to-evolve real estate ecosystem and to materially improve the experience for residents, buyers, sellers, communities, and investors. Today Amherst has over 1000 employees and $14.1 billion in assets under management.

Over the past decade, Amherst has scaled its platform to become one of the largest operators of single-family assets and has acquired, renovated, and leased more than 46,000 homes across 32 markets in the U.S. The firm delivers customized, stabilized cash-flowing portfolios of assets to its investors, wrapped in all the ongoing services required to manage, own, and finance the asset including property management, portfolio management, and a full capital markets team. In addition to its single-family rental platform, Amherst’s debt business pursues two distinct credit strategies in mortgage-backed securities and commercial real estate lending. Amherst is looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as a key member of the Product Team to ensure customer and business expectations are satisfied while identifying innovative opportunities to stay ahead of the curve. - **Hard Working.** You aren’t afraid of a tough deadline.
- **Meticulous.** You are highly structured, disciplined, and take pride in your work.

- **Team Player.** You put team success first and have a high degree of personal character

**What You'll Do:**

- Help define and prioritize the product roadmap based on business/customer ROI by identifying gaps, optimizing the current product features, and uncovering new opportunities through user testing, A/B testing, market research, and customer feedback
- Hyper-focused on ideation, discovery, and execution to build the right things and with speed
- You collect continuous feedback and measure to help evolve the product

- Ability to build strong relationships with key business stakeholders

- Strong analytical, problem solving, and research skills

# Product Manager / Senior Product Manager

$110k - $210k

Blue Rose Research

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2185285827847640718?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6186089846745021610&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Product Manager / Senior Product Manager

Blue Rose Research helps Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We work with campaigns in battleground races up and down the ballot and major Democratic, progressive, and advocacy organizations across the country to produce the research and build the tools they use to decide what to say and where to spend.

We produce opinion research at a scale unmatched in politics, put it directly in decision-makers' hands, and build tools on top of that data that we distribute widely across the progressive ecosystem. You'll be joining a team of decorated engineers, data scientists, and political analysts who have quietly helped shape how the progressive ecosystem communicates for years.

We are hiring a new product manager for our team. You will own a major piece of our research infrastructure and a new polling product we're taking to market this year. You'll need to understand the users, set the roadmap, lead execution with engineering and data science, launch, measure, and improve. Alongside all of this, AI has accelerated what we're able to do, the products we're able to build, and the speed at which we work, and you'll be expected to help keep us on the cutting edge.

Your ultimate objective will be helping Democrats win the 2026 midterms and laying the groundwork for a successful presidential election in 2028. Timelines are tight, the work changes week to week, and the problems are often ambiguous.

We offer a competitive salary, medical, dental, and health benefits, and a work environment that will support your differences. While the work is remote, we do have an office in NYC and a number of folks who work in-person regularly – both in NYC and at shared workspace meetups in DC. Most of our work happens on East Coast time.

You will:

- Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for your product area.
- Spend time with Democratic decision-makers and internal Blue Rose teams, conducting the user research that drives what we build next.
- Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and our research team, writing the specs and development tasks that take products from conception to launch.
- Demo new features to clients, build product marketing materials, and help drive technical partnerships with other firms in the Democratic ecosystem.
- Prototype with coding agents and AI tools to accelerate discovery, analysis, and product definition, and make smart calls about where the latest technology belongs in your roadmap (and where it doesn't).
- Develop a deep understanding of the progressive political ecosystem and the unique needs of campaign professionals.

Our ideal candidate likely:

- Has 2+ years of product management experience in a high-performing product environment, like a high-growth startup, a large technology company, or another organization with rigorous product practices.
- Has owned a software product or substantial product area from discovery through launch and iteration, with specific examples of decisions made and measurable outcomes achieved.
- Can reason about data models, APIs, AI systems, and rough feasibility and cost before validating with engineering, but a software engineering background is not necessary.
- Actively experiments with AI tools and has built useful AI-assisted workflows, even if they have not formally managed an AI product.
- Communicates clearly in writing, demos, and rooms with both engineers and political decision-makers.
- Is energized by ambiguous problems — translating "help win elections" into product bets and learning loops, without a clean quarterly metric to steer by.
- Is motivated by Blue Rose Research's mission and interested in learning the progressive political ecosystem. Prior political or civic-tech experience is welcome but not required.

We don't expect every applicant to have expertise in every area listed above. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the description. Many of our team members have taken an unusual path to get to where they are today, and our unique and diverse perspectives make us more effective. We also believe strongly in our team's ability to learn and grow. Join us!

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $210,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.

# Senior Product Manager

$180k - $190k

Full-time

#paid

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6655847360848157036?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=426&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3450376442780053296&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Us**

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. Our marketplace connects vetted creators with some of the world’s most iconic brands, like McDonald’s, Samsung, and Disney, fostering authentic collaborations that drive real business results. We’ve built a marketplace that solves big challenges in the creator ecosystem, from fair pricing to algorithmic matching and content usage rights, ensuring every partnership is seamless and impactful.

With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.

\\n **The Role**

Senior Product Manager, Data & ML

#paid is building the infrastructure that connects vetted creators with brands like McDonald's, Samsung, and Disney. As Senior Product Manager for our Data & ML squad, you'll own the roadmap for how data, signals, and machine learning power the marketplace.

Your first focus is predictive performance infrastructure, starting with creator–brand match quality: helping brands work with the right creators, and proving that it keeps them with us. You'll build it as the foundation for Forge AI, our AI agent for creators, and for campaign automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own the product roadmap for the Data & ML squad, starting with predictive performance infrastructure and creator–brand match quality.
- Find the signal before building: use data and conversations with brands and creators to learn what actually drives brand retention.
- Turn ML and data capabilities into clear product value for brands and creators, and build them so other products, including Forge AI, can reuse them.
- Partner with Data Product Engineering leads to tie data product strategy to company OKRs and commercial outcomes such as net dollar retention, retention, and contribution margin.
- Define a north star metric for each product or feature, with secondary and counter metrics that signal when something is going wrong.
- Decide when to run experiments, design them, and analyze the results with engineering and data partners.
- Balance brand and creator needs when they compete, and explain the tradeoffs you make.
- Sequence how ML-powered features earn brands' trust, from predictions to recommendations to automated actions.
- Work with design from the start of every project, and make clear go/no-go and deprioritization calls.
- Study competitors and market trends to find opportunities and anticipate constraints.
- Report results, learnings, and next steps clearly.

**To Be Successful, You'll Need**

- 6+ years of product management experience, owning a product area end to end.
- Experience setting a north star metric, with secondary and counter metrics, and using it to make prioritization and go/no-go calls.
- A history of owning roadmaps tied to commercial outcomes, such as NDR, churn reduction, or ARPU growth.
- Comfort with ambiguity: you structure problems, form hypotheses, and find evidence even when data is thin.
- Experience balancing the needs of different user groups, and working with design from the start to resolve the tradeoffs.
- 2+ years on data, ML, or analytics products, including shipping features such as recommendations, ranking, prediction, or scoring end to end.
- The technical fluency to go deep with data and ML engineers, including reading SQL and working in a modern warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
- The ability to turn model outputs and data insights into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders.

**About You**

You see data and ML as a source of lasting advantage, not a feature list. You're comfortable in a SQL query and in a strategy conversation with leadership. You define the problem before you're handed one, and you ask "why" until the real motivation is clear, for brands and creators alike.

You build trust with engineers by respecting their expertise and bringing your own, and you bring design in at the start, not the end. You care about measurable impact, and you understand that good product work connects a possibility to a user benefit to a business outcome. You take ownership of your results and your mistakes, and when user needs conflict with team goals, you put users first.

_Nice to have:_ experience building platforms used by multiple internal teams; working experience with LLMs or AI-native product workflows, such as prompting, agent design, or retrieval-augmented generation; familiarity with creator economy, marketplace, or two-sided platform challenges; and experience building internal data tools for operations and customer success teams.

#### **About the Role**

Seed is seeking a Senior Product Manager (Member Product), reporting to the VP, Digital Product + Ecommerce, to own the end-to-end post-purchase member experience—from the moment a member converts through ongoing retention, cross-sell, and deepening engagement. As Seed expands into retail, Amazon, and new marketplaces, the member experience becomes the connective tissue across channels; this role defines what that experience should become and proves it in the market through rapid experimentation.

#### **What You’ll Do (Essential Functions)**

- Own the end-to-end post-purchase member experience strategy, defining what Seed’s member journey should look and feel like, how it evolves, and what to build to make it real.
- Translate Seed’s science, brand, and retention goals into a clear product vision that earns sustained member engagement.
- Design and run short-cycle experiments that test strategic hypotheses about member behavior and generate real signal.
- Define the membership value architecture, grounded in what members want and what moves retention.
- Own the content delivery strategy that makes science education a retention driver, moving toward dynamic, personalized surfacing.
- Partner with Product Design to set the creative and strategic direction for member-facing experiences, including the member homepage and subscription management.
- Collaborate with Growth Product on the funnel-to-member handoff and cross-sell positioning within the member journey.
- Contribute to multi-category expansion by understanding how multi-product subscription behaviors develop and where the experience must evolve.
- Inform how Seed’s owned digital experience evolves alongside emerging agentic commerce channels.
- Define how Seed’s owned member experience works alongside retail, Amazon, and marketplace channels, giving customers who first find Seed elsewhere a reason to become direct members and keeping the experience consistent wherever members buy.
- Produce a data-grounded product roadmap informed by audience segmentation and multi-product cohort data.
- Present member experience strategy and experiment results to leadership.
- And other ad-hoc responsibilities and projects from time to time based on business needs.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

- Within 6 months: a clear, defensible member experience strategy, and at least two experiments launched and generating real signal.
- Within 12 months: measurable improvement in member retention and multi-product adoption, driven by experience depth rather than discounting.
- Within 12 months: a recommendation on membership tier architecture backed by in-market data.
- Within 12 months: a content delivery system that has moved beyond static logic toward dynamic, personalized surfacing.

#### **Who You Are (Required)**

- 7+ years of product management experience, with significant depth in post-purchase, member, subscriber, or retention-focused product work.
- Experience defining experience strategy from ambiguity—articulating what a product should become and building conviction around that vision.
- A track record of leading cross-functional teams (design, engineering, brand, marketing) by setting strategic direction, not only managing delivery.
- Product experience in DTC ecommerce, including subscription or membership businesses at meaningful scale, and an understanding of retention as an experience problem.
- Analytical fluency, including cohort analysis, LTV modeling, and experiment design.
- Experience with experimentation-driven product development: rapid prototyping, hypothesis-driven testing, and short-cycle iteration.
- Experience writing product strategy documents, PRDs, and experiment briefs, and proficiency with product analytics tools.
- Clear, structured communication that makes complex strategy understandable to senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

#### **Nice to Have (Preferred)**

- Experience in health and wellness or premium consumer brands.
- Familiarity with ecommerce and subscription platforms and modern commerce infrastructure.
- Experience with content-as-product or personalization systems.
- Experience with voice-of-customer measurement such as NPS or CSAT.
- Familiarity with agentic commerce and emerging channels in subscription experiences.
- Experience at an omnichannel brand balancing DTC with retail or marketplace channels.

#### **How You’ll Work**

- Collaborate effectively across teams and disciplines.
- Communicate clearly with relevant stakeholders.
- Navigate changing priorities while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
- Demonstrate Seed’s values through how you work, make decisions, and collaborate.
- Make decisions with incomplete information, and reframe, escalate, or stop stalled work rather than letting it drift.
- **Key partners:** Product Design; Engineering; Brand; Lifecycle Marketing; Growth Product; Member Experience; Data Analytics; Product Marketing.
- Use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to improve productivity and effectiveness in this role.

#### **Work & Physical Requirements**

- This role is primarily performed in a remote, computer-based work environment.
- Ability to perform computer-based work for extended periods, including using a computer, keyboard, and other standard office equipment.
- Ability to participate in virtual meetings and communicate effectively using video conferencing, messaging, email, and other digital collaboration tools.
- Ability to maintain the focus and availability necessary to perform the essential functions of the role during scheduled working hours.
- Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

#### **Compensation:**

The annual pay range for this full-time position is $180k - $195k + equity + benefits across all US locations (this position is 100% remote-US). Our pay ranges are guided by discipline, level and experience required. Within the range, individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including: your specific location, desired skills/ technical competency, relevant experience and advanced education/ training.

**_Work Flexibly_** : Thrive in a remote-first culture that prioritizes autonomy and clarity. You’ll also receive a $750 one-time remote work setup stipend and ongoing access to a $450 quarterly wellness and workplace stipends via JOON.

Payroll Integrations

##### Senior Product Manager

Payroll Integrations is a technology platform that powers secure data connections between payroll providers and the financial and benefits platforms that rely on payroll data. We automate retirement contributions, benefits deductions, and other payroll-based financial workflows by connecting more than 100 payroll providers with 401(k) recordkeepers, benefits platforms, and administrators, so our clients can eliminate manual data exchange.

We are an AI-forward company. Engineering is adopting an agentic-first delivery model, where written implementation specs and test-driven development feed AI agents that generate tests and review pull requests. Product works the same way: we use vetted AI skills and agents to draft and check specifications, aggregate project status, and produce downstream documentation. The judgment stays with the person. The typing does not have to.

##### About the role

We are hiring Senior Product Managers across our product teams as the company scales. Each Senior Product Manager is embedded in one engineering team, such as platform or integrations, and owns that team's initiatives end to end: from the product requirements document through validation, beta, and launch, including the timeline, the dependencies, and the coordination it takes to get there. Project management is a defined part of this role, not an adjacent duty.

You are the connective tissue between business stakeholders, clients, partners, and engineering. You do not need to be a developer. Our engineering team is deeply technical. You do need strong opinions, comfort on client and partner calls, and the ability to turn a messy business conversation into something an engineer can build and QA can prove.

In an agentic-first shop, the specification you write is the input the machine builds from. That makes clear, testable requirements the highest-leverage thing you produce, and this role is built around them.

This position is fully remote for candidates anywhere in the United States. We prefer people who work Eastern time hours.

##### What you will do

- Own your initiatives. Be the named owner and the standing answer on status for every project you hold. (Ownership)
- Write the spec. Turn requests from executives, partners, and clients into PRDs, epics, and stories with testable acceptance criteria before work begins. (Requirements)
- Run the plan. Keep dates, dependencies, and priorities current, and chase blockers to resolution. (Delivery)
- Keep stakeholders aligned. Publish one current status per project for engineering, partners, clients, and the business, and escalate with a clear ask. (Communication)
- Ship to criteria. Define entry and exit criteria for releases and betas, equip downstream teams before go-live, and close each beta with a written decision. (Launch)
- Be the product voice. Represent your team's roadmap on client calls, partner discussions, and product demos.
- Triage inquiries. Manage intake for requests in your team's area and communicate status to stakeholders.
- Keep Jira and Confluence as the source of truth for requirements and project status.
- Use AI daily. Draft and stress-test specs, pull status, and generate documentation with our vetted skills and agents. You own every word that ships.
- Raise the practice. Set the pattern other product managers work to: your specs, plans, and beta playbooks are the ones the team reuses. (Leadership)

##### What you bring

- Experience. Seven or more years of product management at a SaaS company, with a track record of owning delivery end to end and writing acceptance criteria, user stories, and PRDs in an Agile environment.
- Communication. You can absorb a messy client or executive conversation and return it as something an engineer can start on and QA can prove without a second conversation.
- Judgment and opinions. You make and defend calls at your level, push back with evidence and an alternative when a request cannot be built, scheduled, or reconciled with an existing commitment, and hold the scope line under pressure.
- Project management discipline. You have run plans with real dates and dependencies, and you treat schedule and follow-through as core product work rather than overhead.
- Fluency with AI tools. You already use LLM assistants to draft, summarize, and check your own work, and you can tell good output from plausible-sounding output.
- Tooling. Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for backlog and requirements management.
- Client and partner-facing comfort. Product calls, partner discussions, and occasional demos.

##### Nice to have

- Experience in fintech, payroll, HR tech, benefits administration, or retirement
- Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, or payroll data concepts
- Experience with spec-driven or AI-assisted development workflows
- This role is fully remote, but we would love to find someone who wants to spend some time in our Marietta, GA office

##### Compensation and benefits

- $150,000 – $225,000
- Fully remote (US), Eastern time preferred
- Unlimited PTO
- Comprehensive health benefits
- 401(k) with company match

# Senior Product Manager

Nomina

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9109778099994232598?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7831104329082051690&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager

Remote

##### About

We're building Nomina: a platform allowing power users to access onchain markets and run sophisticated trading strategies in a single interface. We're looking for early team members to help us bring this ambitious vision to life. We're a team who already built a platform that processed over $70M leading to our $18M fundraise from top investors including Pantera, Two Sigma Ventures, Coinbase Ventures alongside angel investors including Stani Kulechov (founder of Aave), Sandeep Nailwal (cofounder of Polygon) and more. We are growing rapidly and we need ambitious and experienced team members to join us to help scale crypto's future.

##### About the Role

Establish world-class product discovery practices while identifying and dominating our first niche in the onchain trading ecosystem, setting the foundation for our vision to become the go-to terminal of the onchain economy.

##### Outcomes

Month 1:

- Implement structured user research process and complete 20+ user interviews.
- Work with CEO to aggregate user interview feedback and prioritize development.
- Work with CTO to turn user feedback into concrete engineering plans.

Month 2:

- First experiments live with measurable success criteria.
- Running user interviews reverse-shadowed by CEO.
- Running engineering standups, planning, retros, and prioritizing engineering work with CTO oversight.

Month 3:

- Build-measure-learn loops are in full swing, iterating on the product quickly in response to constant user feedback.
- Fully owning user research conversations.
- Fully owning engineering planning and prioritization.

##### What Success Looks Like

- You're talking to users daily and shipping improvements weekly
- Engineers come to you excited about user insights
- We have a clear thesis on our first niche within 90 days

##### Requirements

- 5+ years of PM experience with at least 2 years in product discovery/0-to-1
- Strong working knowledge of financial products (spot, futures, yield, options, perps). Must be able to reason about how these products work, their mechanics, and what traders care about. Experience as a trader, quant, analyst, or having built in this domain is a plus
- Track record of finding PMF in ambiguous spaces
- Excellence at user research and synthesis
- Located in US or Europe
- Able to quickly and efficiently convert user research into actionable engineering work

##### Competencies

- Customer centric orientation — actively thinks about how to improve the user experience of trading on Nomina
- User research mastery – design and execute user research, build lasting relationships with users, transform qualitative insights into quantitative experiments
- Detail oriented – every pixel matters. Ensure the user experience is perfect
- Autonomous — specifically seeks to take greater ownership and responsibility and thrives in their personal growth by doing so
- Action oriented — we are looking for people who take action by default, consistently driving forward progress without asking for permission
- Highly intelligent — learns quickly and can participate in abstract intellectually engaging conversations
- Effective communicator — clearly articulates ideas and engages in debates in a productive manner that leads us to making better decisions

##### Nice to Haves

- Experience with trading platforms or financial products
- Familiarity with crypto/DeFi (can be learned if you're sharp)
- Technical background (helpful but not required)

##### Benefits

Our benefits include competitive compensation, token packages for all employees, regular team off-sites around the world and unlimited PTO. In addition, you'll join a team of high-caliber people innovating at the frontier of crypto that work collaboratively to help one another accelerate their personal growth.

##### Values

We are a mission driven company. We believe deeply that through software engineering we can build a self-sovereign society. In our day to day, we make decisions based upon our company values and operating principles:

- Customer centricity
- Long-term orientation
- Courage
- High-trust & autonomy
- Kindness & respect
- Collaboration
- Humility & low-ego
- Transparency
- Data driven
- Precise communication
- Results oriented
- Kerplunk: clean handoffs and acknowledgement of ownership between team members

The future belongs to all of us, independent of our origins. Nomina is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender or any other status protected under federal, state or local law.

# Senior Product Manager

Full-time

Certara

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2475112687814715174?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2129029511405480028&crId=US_0US_0)

**Overview**

**Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.**

**Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.**

**Senior Product Managers will deliver value to clients via improvements to our software product offerings. Specifically, you will identify problems and opportunities to direct our engineering R&D efforts and the improvements that create the most value—optimizing complex trade-offs in the process.**

**You sit at the intersection of business, UX design, and technology. You feel at home empathizing with customers’ business challenges, sharing thoughtful insights with product designers, writing detailed specifications for developers, passionately sharing your ideas to executives, politely saying “no”, making tough decisions without all the information you’d like, and pouring through data to extract the key insight, … all in the same day. You thrive on creating order from chaos and are a passionate advocate for creating systems and processes to avoid having to do the same thing twice.**

**Responsibilities**

**- Translate users' experiences, usability feedback, unmet needs, and satisfaction levels into requirements and user stories**
**- Drive development of new features and enhancements through definition, planning, design, build, and launch phases of product development**
**- Glean critical feedback from users during the product discovery process to refine designs and reduce risks**
**- Clearly communicate customer stories, pain points, and product benefits to our users and internal stakeholders**
**- Collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data to inform decision-making, drive adoption and assess impact of decisions (build-measure-learn)**
**- Define requirements and evaluation criteria for AI/LLM-enabled authoring capabilities (e.g., prompt design, retrieval, human-in-the-loop review); partner with data scientists and data engineers to measure and optimize output quality, latency, and cost**
**- Promote Certara products in presentations, webinars, workshops, events, and conferences**
**- Author best practice guides and help articles; create in-app help and instructional tips for user onboarding**
**- Curate product knowledge to efficiently distribute key knowledge to various stakeholder communities and customers**

**Qualifications**

**- BS/BA in science or technology related field**
**- 5+ years in product management or equivalent role**
**- Ability to work in a remote position requiring constant spoken and written communication; skill in exerting influence at all levels of the organization without leverage or managerial authority**
**- Systems-thinking and ability to anticipate and communicate downstream implications of today's decisions**
**- Experience working with data engineering teams on data pipelines, data quality, and integration requirements**
**- High tolerance for ambiguity, low tolerance for mess; able to create order out of chaos, attend to details, and push quality higher**
**- Relentlessly resourceful and discerning in solving problems independently vs. seeking help from others; brave yet humble in working across multi-disciplinary teams where each person is more of an expert than you in their chosen field**
**- Eager to constantly learn and improve, flexible in adapting to change, comfortable in growing through successes and setbacks**
**- Fastidious for facts, insistent on evidence- and data-driven choices, able to separate signal from noise**
**- Able to effortlessly tune communication style and approach for maximum results with varied audiences such as Engineering, Sales, Product Managers, Executives, and Customers**

**Experience with software tools for**

**- Product lifecycle management software (e.g. JIRA, Aha!, Rally)**
**- Data Analysis and Analytics (e.g. Excel, SQL, Tableau, AWS QuickSight)**
**- Customer Usage Analytics (e.g. MixPanel, Amplitude, Pendo, Google Analytics)**
**- Generative AI/LLM platforms and evaluation (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG, model evaluation frameworks)**
**- Document authoring/structured content tools (e.g., Word, template and content management systems)**

**Preferred Qualifications**

**- Experience designing products and collaborating with highly educated technical users such as scientists, mathematicians, programmers, or regulatory medical writers**
**- Education or qualifications relating to business, programming, data science, health sciences, medical writing, customer support, project management, or corporate communications**
**- Experience working for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) vendor, clinical laboratory, pharmaceutical company, or Contract Research Organization (CRO), specifically in functions supporting External Data, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Pharmacometrics, Regulatory/Medical Writing, Clinical Operations, or CDISC data submissions**

**Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.**

**Innovate with purpose**

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

**Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company**

Join BILL as a Senior Product Manager on the Cards team and help shape how small and midsize businesses issue, manage, and grow through card-based payments. BILL's Cards team sits at the heart of the company's highest-revenue product line, owning the full suite of card experiences that power corporate spend, accounts payable workflows for SMBs, their accountants, and the vendors who get paid through virtual card. Card issuance drives significant BILL revenue and payments volume today, and the team operates with startup speed inside a scaled fintech: high ownership, cross-functional by default, and outcome-focused at every step.

In this role, you will own the product strategy and execution for BILL's AP card and virtual card issuance, covering SMB, commercial card and the virtual card instrument used across corporate spend, accounts payable and accounts receivable surfaces (credit, debit, and new products). You will work at the intersection of card domain expertise and product-led growth, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, CX, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to bring card products to customers, drive adoption, and grow usage over time. This is a role for someone who understands the card issuance stack, partner and network landscape, and unit economics of a card, knows how to build great experiences for diverse customer types across various channels of card payments, and wants to drive measurable customer delight and revenue outcomes through product.

**Responsibilities:**

- Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for BILL's AP card and virtual card issuance, with a focus on driving card adoption, engagement, and revenue growth.
- Define and evolve the card product for multiple customer segments: the SMB accounts payable user, the accountant managing a book of clients, and the virtual card supplier receiving payment.
- Bring deep understanding of card issuance mechanics including auth, processing, BIN sponsorship, transaction settlement, unit economics, and partner ecosystems to influence how BILL configures and scales its card offerings across use cases and channels.
- Own and execute the card issuance and experience roadmap, delivering reliability and resiliency across all payments surfaces while introducing new card product offerings that grow the business.
- Identify and execute product-led growth opportunities that turn one-time card users into repeat, high-engagement customers, reducing reliance on manual activation and support.
- Partner cross-functionally across Engineering, Design, CX, Ops, Marketing, and Sales to deliver card experiences that are intuitive, reliable, and differentiated in the SMB market.
- Define success metrics for your areas, instrument the right tracking, and use data alongside qualitative customer insight to guide prioritization and validate outcomes.
- Bring a hands-on AI mindset: fluent with AI-assisted tools for research, prioritization, and PRD writing, and capable of evaluating where AI capabilities can create durable product differentiation in the card and product development.

**We'd love to chat if you have:**

- 5+ years of product management experience owning payments or card products, with demonstrated ownership of both product strategy and execution in a fast-moving fintech or startup environment.
- Hands-on experience with card issuance, virtual card, commercial card, corporate spend, or adjacent payments infrastructure, including working knowledge of card issuance, unit economics, and the partner relationships that make card products viable.
- A track record of building product experiences that drive customer adoption and engagement, not just shipping features, with the ability to connect product decisions to revenue and retention outcomes.
- Strong product sense and comfort operating with ambiguous data, defining your own success metrics, and making prioritization decisions without a fully mapped playbook.
- Experience collaborating across a wide cross-functional surface including Engineering, Design, Operations, and Go-To-Market in a fast-moving environment.

**Desired Qualifications:**

- Experience with corporate spend, accounts payable workflows, or SMB card payments giving you context on how card products fit into how businesses actually manage spend.
- Familiarity with card issuance platforms and partners, product-led growth principles, and experience applying them to financial products or multi-sided customer ecosystems.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

##### Senior Product Manager

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a fast-growing, enterprise-grade software organization building next-generation infrastructure for institutional applications is seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Product Manager to lead its tokenization and capital markets product capabilities.

In this role, the selected candidate will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for high-growth enterprise features tailored directly to Tier-1 financial institutions, including global banks, asset managers, custodians, and payment networks. Serving as the core product owner for up-market capabilities, this role sits at the intersection of technical innovation and complex institutional requirements—translating deep financial market insights into scalable, production-ready enterprise software.

This position is ideal for a hands-on, high-agency product manager with a substantive background in traditional finance, deep familiarity with market infrastructure, and a proven ability to lead technical discussions with CTOs, Heads of Operations, and enterprise engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define, prioritize, and execute the product roadmap for enterprise-focused capabilities, including privacy models, partner integrations, and flexible deployment models ranging from managed services to institution-operated environments.
- Institutional & Partner Collaboration: Drive cross-team alignment with strategic development partners and modular platform providers to integrate customer discovery learnings into a cohesive, institutional-grade product suite.
- Enterprise Deal & Sales Support: Partner directly with go-to-market teams during high-value sales cycles with Tier-1 financial services institutions (FSIs), providing deep product expertise during technical evaluations, InfoSec reviews, RFPs, and pilot-to-production transitions.
- Customer Discovery & Rapid Prototyping: Conduct structured customer discovery with institutional stakeholders and utilize AI-assisted tools to build early-stage prototypes, specifications, and testable artifacts to accelerate feedback loops ahead of full engineering cycles.
- Competitive & Market Intelligence: Track and analyze developments across capital markets technology, enterprise tokenization, and private/public blockchain ecosystems to inform product positioning and long-term roadmap decisions.
- Repeatable Go-to-Market Assets: Codify successful deployment motions into repeatable product narratives, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept frameworks for priority financial services use cases.

Job Summary In this role, you will own the health facility-specific initiatives, which include integrating with partners, handling complex data flows, and ensuring a seamless rollout of new features. Demonstrated leadership abilities, with experience driving results in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Agile /Lean methodologies and product management. # Senior Product Manager

$170k - $190k

Full-time

Spark Advisors
