## About Spark Advisors We're building healthcare tech for a system that desperately needs it. Each year, millions of Americans deal with confusing changes to their Medicare plans that impact their prescriptions, access to care, and pocketbooks. These aren’t just inconveniences – they are potentially life-altering changes that leave seniors medically and financially vulnerable. Independent Medicare advisors play a crucial role in guiding seniors through this complexity and helping them find the right coverage for their needs. But their ability to be effective healthcare advocates has long been hamstrung by broken tools and outdated systems. Spark is fixing that. We’re the fastest-growing Medicare platform in the country, combining AI, an industry-leading CRM, and client services to transform how 10,000+ brokers acquire, enroll, and support clients in their local communities. Join a talent-dense team from Square, Ramp, Yext, Oscar, and Cedar — backed by Primary Ventures and Viewpoint Ventures — that is serious about building technology to expand access to quality healthcare. We offer remote work, sabbaticals, company retreats, and other generous benefits that earned us recognition as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces of 2025 Healthcare is overdue for innovation. Let’s redefine what its future looks like — together.

## Summary

Spark is transforming how Medicare agencies operate and this role sits at the heart of that transformation. You’ll lead the product vision for automating the manual, error-prone workflows that currently power agent book of business, enrollment, retention,, and compliance workflows. This is one of the most technically and operationally complex areas at Spark: hundreds of edge cases, fragmented data sources, and high-stakes financial flows that must “just work”. If that sounds like an exciting problem to unknot, you might just be who we are looking for.

This role is a part of Spark's broker experience team: the CRM, quoting, and enrollment tools that brokers use every day. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help make those workflows faster, simpler, and smarter.

We're looking for someone comfortable operating independently and partnering with senior stakeholders, including C-level leadership at a fast-moving Series B startup. Ideally you're a strong generalist, and you bring deep workflow intuition and regulatory awareness to the role.

## What You'll Do

- Collaborate with engineering and design to define product specs, ship high-quality features, and drive adoption
- Conduct user research and gather feedback from brokers and internal teams to identify pain points and improvement opportunities.
- Use data to evaluate product performance, measure outcomes, and inform decisions.
- Act as a subject matter expert in your domain and ensure alignment with broader product strategy
- Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problems and workstreams
- Support release planning and ensure features meet quality and usability expectations before launch.
- Help define and evolve product processes as Spark scales - balancing speed and rigor.

## What We're Looking For

- You have a track record for managing a successful product domain, ideally in B2B SaaS or platform products
- You write clear product specs and have strong instincts for when to be scrappy vs when to be rigorous.
- Comfortable moving between discovery and delivery - from user interviews to writing detailed user stories.
- You're comfortable navigating cross-functional work and can clearly communicate decisions and tradeoffs
- You use data to inform decisions, whether through dashboards, SQL, or close partnership with data teams
- You've seen products through multiple launch cycles and know how to set goals, measure impact, and iterate
- You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and take ownership without waiting to be asked
- You're deeply empathetic toward all the different internal and external stakeholders you work with

Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity. **Why you should join our team**

By joining Spark, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup where you will have a profound impact on the brokers and beneficiaries we serve. And you'll learn, grow, be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to help you and your family thrive. We're committed to supporting your happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing a comprehensive benefits program. In addition to your base salary, we also offer:

# Senior Product Manager

Full-time

ANOVA

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1985582200496737038?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4010889575060581004&crId=US_0US_0)

Join us on the Product Management team as a Senior Product Manager – LPG and Fuels & Lubricants. In this role, you will own the Anova Unify product direction for the LPG and Fuels & Lubricants (F&L) markets, translating a deep understanding of how propane, fuel, and lubricant distributors run their operations into software that helps them serve their customers more efficiently and grow. You’ll set the vertical strategy, lead customer discovery, and own the go-to-market for your markets, partnering closely with the platform Product Management team, Hardware Product Management, and Engineering. Start your journey with Anova today!

Outcomes you’ll own:

- Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your passion for understanding LPG and F&L distributors, their delivery and supply operations, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the company that best understands how IoT creates value for our customers as they serve their own.

- Greater than 90% customer device productivity. Keep customers’ device portfolios live, healthy, and reporting by solving real, value-adding problems and delivering best-in-class reliability, so customers see clear reason to keep every device active.

- Net Revenue Retention and customer value. Customers in your markets renew, expand, and advocate. You own the product-side inputs to NRR (adoption, engagement, and satisfaction), track measurable customer outcomes such as reduced operating costs and faster time-to-value, and make disciplined trade-offs to protect gross margin.

- Set domain strategy. Define the multi-year product vision for the LPG and F&L markets, grounded in customer insight, competitive dynamics, industry trends, and Anova’s strategic priorities. Build an evidence-backed roadmap the organization trusts, defining the metric before you ship the feature. Partner with platform Product Management to shape shared capabilities around your markets’ needs, and keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing aligned on what’s being built and why so ambiguity is resolved upstream, not during delivery.

- Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs with LPG and F&L customers, including interviews, site visits, usage analysis, and win/loss reviews, and stay engaged with the industry through trade associations and events. Develop a differentiated point of view on what these customers need, what they’ll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage in your markets.

- Drive AI-first product thinking. Identify where ML and AI (forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, workflow automation) create meaningful customer value in your markets. Decide what to build, buy, or partner for, and move it from idea to shipped capability, while using AI as leverage in your own research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis.

- Partner with engineering on architecture and trade-offs. Engage credibly on system design, API contracts, data models, and integration architecture. Make principled trade-offs between scope, speed, and technical quality, and document your reasoning.

- Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova’s physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact, and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.

- Own the go-to-market. Define pricing and positioning for the LPG and F&L markets in partnership with Marketing and Sales leadership. Enable the field with vertical-specific competitive intelligence, winning narratives, and objection handling that reflect how these customers buy.

- Shape the customer success motion. Codify what success looks like for customers in your markets. Influence the playbooks, onboarding milestones, health scoring, and AI-assisted scale programs that Customer Success runs, and make sure the team is ready to help customers get value from every release.

- Mentor and develop PMs. Coach junior and mid-level PMs on discovery methods, spec quality, prioritization discipline, and stakeholder communication. Write the specs, strategy memos, and decision frameworks others learn from, and raise the bar for honest, evidence-based decision-making across the team.


What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

- 10+ years of professional experience in product management, engineering, solutions/technical consulting, or a closely adjacent technical function, including 6+ years specifically in product management — with at least two full product lifecycles owned end-to-end as the directly responsible PM, from problem definition through measurable outcomes.
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- You’ve built from scratch more than once — new products, new markets, new internal capabilities — and you have the experience to prove it. The more times you’ve started from nothing and shipped something that mattered, the better.
- Demonstrated track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software that drove material business results — measured in adoption, retention, or revenue.
- Experience owning multi-year product strategy and translating it into a prioritized, evidence-backed roadmap.
- Deep customer discovery practice — structured interview programs, synthesis frameworks, and the ability to build conviction from ambiguous signals.
- Demonstrated experience using AI and LLM tools in a product management context (research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight), and a clear, developed point of view on how AI should show up in B2B industrial products, both internally and in customer-facing capability.
- Ability to write compelling, structured strategy documents, specs, and narratives for executive and cross-functional audiences.
- Strong technical fluency — able to engage credibly on APIs, data models, integration architecture, and system trade-offs with engineering leaders.
- Data fluency: design metrics frameworks, build instrumentation plans, analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence-based roadmap calls.
- Experience owning or significantly influencing pricing, positioning, and go-to-market decisions for a product area.

Preferred Qualifications -

- MBA

- Familiarity with the LPG/propane, fuels, and/or lubricants industries, including how distributors manage delivery, supply, and customer operations.

- Prior product management in IIoT, connected-hardware, or industrial technology environments.

- Experience shipping ML or AI-driven features — forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, or workflow automation — in a SaaS environment.

- Background in venture or private-equity-backed high-growth industrial technology companies.

- Experience mentoring or managing junior PMs or leading a product pod.

- Domain knowledge in industrial operations, field service, supply chain, or logistics.

- Experience with enterprise integration patterns — ERP, dispatch, routing, or billing system connectivity.

Physical Requirements -

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 30–40% domestically and internationally.

Work Authorization -

For this role Anova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

ABOUT ANOVA

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

# Senior Product Manager

GREY

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8656885977874722235?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3945124849582830500&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager

Grey is a fast-growing company building the future of global banking for a borderless world. We provide multi-currency accounts, instant international transfers, and virtual cards that enable individuals and businesses to manage money across borders as easily as in their local currency. We serve digital nomads, remote workers, freelancers, international students, entrepreneurs, and anyone whose financial life crosses borders.

Licensed and regulated in multiple countries, Grey is expanding rapidly across global markets. We're a remote company with staff around the world.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a product area end to end as a hands-on individual contributor, accountable for its roadmap, metrics and unit economics. You will report to the Head of Product and work with engineers, designers, data, marketing and compliance to ensure your product is successful.

What you'll do

- Own the roadmap for your product area, tying every bet to a clear business outcome such as revenue, retention or margin.
- Run the product lifecycle from problem definition to launch and iteration, using customer insight and data.
- Own the unit economics of what you build: you know what each user and transaction earns and costs.
- Design and run experiments, including A/B tests, and act on the results.
- Use Amplitude and Metabase to set metrics, track results and decide what to build, fix or stop.
- Use AI in your daily work to multiply your output: research, analysis, specs, prototyping and decision-making.
- Work with partners, compliance, support, growth and leadership to align priorities and drive adoption.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a senior or lead role.
- A track record of scaling products, with results you can quantify.
- Strong command of unit economics: you can model contribution margin per user or per transaction and trade it off against growth.
- Data-driven by habit: hands-on with Amplitude and Metabase, comfortable defining metrics and digging into the data yourself.
- Comfortable designing and running experiments, including A/B tests, and acting on the results.
- Well versed in using AI tools to multiply your productivity and the quality of your work.
- Solid grasp of how software gets built, and the ability to work closely with engineers.
- Excellent written and verbal communication for a distributed, global audience.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

- Experience in fintech: payments, wallets or financial services.
- Familiarity with cross-border payments, remittances or digital wallets, ideally in emerging markets.
- An MBA or advanced degree.

# Senior Product Manager

Pulse iD

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1970653565636837233?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4537305895637721540&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager

Pulse iD is a global fintech leader specializing in AI-powered loyalty and rewards solutions. Our platform empowers financial institutions, enterprises, and merchants to engage customers through personalized offers, gamification, and real-time pricing. We are committed to continuous innovation and delivering high-ROI solutions that drive business growth and customer satisfaction. Join us in shaping the future of customer engagement and redefining the banking experience worldwide.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager with a strong background in product management, business analysis, or product ownership within a technology-driven software product development environment. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing digital products and a strong understanding of working closely with engineering and technical teams throughout the product lifecycle.

The candidate should have the ability to take end-to-end ownership of product delivery, from defining requirements and prioritizing features to execution, delivery, and continuous improvement. Experience in domains such as FinTech, payments, credit card platforms, e-commerce platforms, or other technology-based products will be highly valued.

This role requires a proactive product leader who can bridge business needs and technical capabilities, drive product strategy, and successfully deliver scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.

##### Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and prioritize product requirements, including functional, technical, and user experience aspects.
- Work closely with cross-functional teams, including development, design, and marketing, to ensure alignment and successful product delivery.
- Conduct a comprehensive analysis of market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback to inform product roadmap decisions.
- Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather and refine product requirements, ensuring clear documentation and communication throughout the development lifecycle.
- Monitor key performance indicators and metrics to assess product performance and identify opportunities for improvement or optimization.

##### Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Minimum 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Business Analysis roles within a technology-driven software product environment.
- Proven experience managing complex digital products and platforms, involving multiple stakeholders, integrations, workflows, data flows, and technical dependencies.
- Hands-on experience owning products within one or more of the following domains is highly preferred:

 - FinTech platforms
 - Digital banking solutions
 - Payments platforms / payment gateways
 - Credit card platforms
 - Loyalty, rewards, and customer engagement platforms
 - E-commerce marketplaces or transaction-based platforms
 - AI-powered personalization, pricing, or analytics platforms

- Experience working closely with engineering teams, architects, UX/UI designers, and business stakeholders throughout the full product lifecycle - from discovery and requirements definition through delivery and continuous optimisation.
- Strong understanding of product management practices, including roadmap planning, feature prioritisation, user story creation, backlog management, requirement elicitation, and Agile delivery methodologies.
- Ability to translate complex business problems into clear technical requirements and actionable product solutions.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions across technical and business teams.
- Demonstrated experience successfully delivering scalable products or major product features used by customers, enterprises, or external partners.
- Familiarity with AI, machine learning, data analytics, and recommendation / personalisation concepts is an advantage.
- Must be a self-driven individual contributor who can independently own product responsibilities while collaborating effectively within a global cross-functional team.

##### Why Join Us:

- Be part of a visionary company that is transforming the loyalty and payments landscape.
- Engage with top-tier clients including major banks and financial institutions.
- Enjoy the flexibility of remote work with a talented and supportive team.
- Opportunities for professional growth and development in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

##### Senior Product Manager

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

We are seeking a highly analytical, experimentation-driven Senior Product Manager, Member Engagement to own the full member (user) journey—from first touch through exam completion and repeat usage. This PM will drive the roadmap for identity, onboarding, engagement, and conversion funnels, ensuring members can effortlessly register, schedule, and complete their imaging exams. This is a high-impact, growth-oriented IC role responsible for increasing registration rates, improving funnel performance, and boosting completion rates across the member experience.

Reporting to the Director of Product, you will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Engineering, Design, Data, Member Services, and Customer Support to create a seamless, intuitive, and conversion-optimized experience that drives measurable business outcomes.

**What you'll do:**

- Own and optimize the end-to-end member engagement and activation roadmap, including login, registration, onboarding, identity flows, member home, and profile management.
- Build intuitive, frictionless experiences that improve registration rate, increase order initiation, and boost exam completion.
- Design and execute rigorous A/B tests and experimentation frameworks to identify improvements across the funnel, from first touch to order completion and follow-through.
- Partner closely with Marketing and Growth to ensure cohesive messaging, personalized journeys, and high-performing acquisition-to-activation handoffs.
- Work tightly with Engineering, Design, and Data to ship high-quality product experiences with clear requirements, strong technical understanding, and crisp execution.
- Leverage analytics tools (Amplitude, Looker, SQL) to develop insights, diagnose friction points, and uncover opportunities to increase funnel efficiency and retention.
- Contribute to scheduling and payments-related enhancements that improve the overall member journey and reduce drop-off, even if not part of your core scope.
- Represent engagement performance, insights, roadmap, and experiments to leadership with clarity, data rigor, and a deep understanding of member behavior.
- Lead stakeholder alignment across Marketing, Growth, Member Services, Provider Ops, and Operations, ensuring cross-functional clarity and strong roadmap buy-in.
- Champion the voice of the member by running research, usability sessions, and journey mapping to drive thoughtful, human-centered improvements.

**About you:**

- 5–8+ years of product management experience, ideally within growth, consumer engagement, or funnel optimization roles.
- Proven ability to meaningfully improve funnel performance—registration, activation, conversion, and completion—through experimentation and data-driven decision-making.
- Hands-on experience with SQL and modern analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, or GA.
- Strong background in A/B testing, hypothesis design, statistical thinking, and rapid iteration loops.
- Deep comfort in discovering friction across identity, onboarding, login/registration, and member engagement flows and turning insights into prioritizable product work.
- Exceptional stakeholder management skills; able to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment across Marketing, Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations.
- Experience with scheduling, appointment booking, or payments flows is a plus.
- Strong consumer instincts and a passion for building simple, elegant experiences that reduce friction and drive measurable business results.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with a bias toward action, impact, and collaboration.

The base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $150,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.

£50k - £70k per year

Maneno ApS

##### Senior Product Manager

At Maneno we are passionate about reading. So much that we have devoted all our energy for the past 6 years to build the world's best reading app for children in the age group 5-11. Some refer to us as the "Spotify for children's books", but we actually think of ourselves as the company that gets kids excited by reading.

Why?

Because we are transforming the way of reading from being a lonely activity to a social activity

Because we enrich stories with fun games that can be played alone or together with friends

Because we reward kids for their reading effort and make them think of reading as a game rather than a cumbersome activity that your parents tell them to do.

Maneno is currently used by over 25.000 kids each month and we are right now expanding globally to unlock the power of reading for all children in the world.

We're also backed by leading digital investors - Founders Factory (a market leading accelerator founded by Brent Hoberman of lastminute.com and MADE.com) and North East Venture.

##### Job Description

We are looking for an experienced product person to become our Product Manager. You will be leading the vision, the user experience, the roadmap and the product team of one of the most exciting and innovative companies in the EdTech space. You are someone who is inspired by the problem space and not just the solution. Our ideal candidate is an original thinker with a highly creative mind, makes data-driven product decisions, has excellent communication skills, user experience knowledge and strong vision.

Your responsibilities

You will be responsible for managing the full product lifecycle, from vision to development, testing, deployment and feedback loop.

You will be responsible for overall user retention and make sure that users keep coming back for more.

You will develop the roadmap for the product along with the project and resource plans required to deliver the roadmap.

You will manage the teams involved in the development of the application, collaborating with Engineers, Product designers, and Marketing and Operations teams to define, scope, prioritise, develop, test and deliver features across our internal and customer facing products.

You will use quantitative analysis methods to define and analyse key metrics, A/B testing and multivariate testing

You will take responsibility for turning Maneno's mission and strategy into a market leading application.

You are creative - relentlessly striving to identify new technical solutions and innovations for our product.

Be deeply truth-seeking. Collect whatever data is necessary to inform product direction and user experience

Lead the creation of pragmatic, prioritised, actionable roadmaps

Create strategies to ensure the wider team are delivering on goals and constantly improving the business proposition.

Be hands-on and willing to get involved in all aspects of the product process

##### Qualifications

Must have:

Previous product management experience, with some of that experience gained in the area of consumer mobile applications.

A proven track record of delivering successful products at scale for web and mobile platforms, including conception, implementation and delivery. You will have a track record of building user experience that our users love.

Project management experience, driving projects that deliver on time and budget

A practitioner of agile and lean methodologies

You will have experience with an application that has >100k users

User testing experience

Analytics experience

Nice to have:

Experience working with remote development team

Release management experience

Prior experience in juggling multiple projects and delegating work effectively, iteratively implementing operational improvements to the way you and your team works.

Experience in working with cross-functional teams and can communicate effectively with all parts of a startup business

A deep knowledge in analytics tools such as Mixpanel, CleverTap

Experience working with EdTech and gamification - maybe you have previously worked at Duolingo, Kahoot or Education First?

Experience working with story-driven game design, taps and sinks diagrams etc.

Personality

Driven by finding the root cause of any issue, rather putting a patch over them, with sound judgement and problem-solving ability at all levels. Comfortable making decisions and taking risks where necessary.

Fun and enjoys the work - we all love what we do!

A team player, willing to get your hands dirty with the detail

Inquisitive and curious

Analytic and bases decision on data

Organised with a strong attention to detail and an ability to balance detail with the big picture.

Ability to lead a team to perform at their best

##### Additional Information

Salary between £50 - £70k depending on experience

Share options

Opportunity for you to shape one of the most exciting and innovative products that help kids to read

Make your mark on the business - as a small team everyone's opinion and drive counts. You will be a key player in the business.

Freedom to work from where you see fit

Flexible working hours

Absolute work title freedom

Team building trips

Coffee, tea, fruit and snacks

**Senior Product Manager**

Virtualitics Iris and Forward Deployed Applications

Remote (DC area preferred) \| Active Security Clearance or Security Clearance Eligibility \| HQ: Pasadena, CA

Virtualitics builds AI-native readiness intelligence for the US and allied nations' defense sector. Our IRO application layer and Virtualitics AI Platform (VAIP) transform how defense organizations act on maintenance, logistics, and global force management data. Our team is actively refining agentic workflows, composable AI agents, and generative interfaces to replace static dashboards with dynamic, conversational intelligence.

**The Role**

You will work closely with cross-functional peers to drive product direction while ensuring day-to-day operational efficiency from the product development team. You will work with the engineering and AI team to make architecture decisions, scope sprints, run demos, and pressure-test trade-offs in real time. The product serves two audiences: DoD operators and delivery teams (data scientists, engineers, partner integrators) who configure and maintain deployments of Virtualitics' product offering.

**Responsibilities**

- **Own your product deployment end-to-end:** requirements, backlog, sprint planning, scope decisions, releases, and outcomes.
- **Drive technical decisions with engineering:** architecture, feasibility, trade-offs. Challenge estimates that don't add up.
- **Bridge users and engineers:** translate operational readiness problems into product requirements through direct user research. You'll be hands on with real users.
- **Shape platform evolution:** R&D work across data ontology management, agent orchestration (MCP/A2A), generative interfaces.
- **Support delivery operations:** ensure the product reduces manual effort across contract types and deployment models.
- **Communicate clearly:** executive briefings, demos, PRDs, strategic docs, cross-functional alignment. You are the connective tissue.

**Qualifications**

- US Citizen with active Secret (or above) DoW clearance (or ability to obtain quickly)
- CS degree (or equivalent technical degree) or 1-2 years of software engineering experience
- 4+ years of product management or software engineering experience shipping software in agile environments
- Comfortable reading code, reviewing architecture, and holding your own in technical discussions
- Excellent written and verbal communication.

**Preferred:**

- Experience with AI/ML products, defense/government tech, or classified environments (SIPR/NIPR)
- Startup experience, especially navigating the scalability and automation phase
- Platform product experience: technical interfaces (APIs, SDKs) alongside standard web applications

**Compensation**

- Competitive salary, equity, and performance bonus
- Medical, dental, vision. Unlimited PTO.
- Growth path to Staff and Group Product Manager

##### Senior Product Manager

ComPsych is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResources and AbsenceResources solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries.

We're modernizing how ComPsych builds products — making our product development lifecycle AI-native from discovery through delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design end to end. As we turn services historically delivered by our Operations and Customer Success teams into digital products, their frontline knowledge of customers and how the product is actually used becomes essential input, so partnering with them closely is part of the job.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who already uses AI throughout the product lifecycle and wants to help shape how our Product organization works going forward. This is a high-leverage role: you'll spend more time on the judgment calls only a PM can make — framing the problem, validating what AI surfaces, deciding what actually matters — than on the manual research, drafting, and synthesis AI now does well. You'll use assistants like Claude and ChatGPT daily to accelerate research, requirements, and prototyping, then apply your own product judgment to what comes back before it shapes the roadmap.

##### Primary Responsibilities

- Own product strategy and roadmap as your core contribution. You set direction for your business unit — priorities, tradeoffs, and the roadmap — and align leadership and cross-functional teams around it.
- Direct AI-accelerated discovery, not manual synthesis. Use AI to turn customer interviews, support tickets, competitor material, and market research into insights — then apply judgment to what's actually true and what matters.
- Draft requirements with AI, then own the judgment calls. PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria start with AI — you validate scope, edge cases, dependencies, and prioritization before the team builds against them.
- Prototype before you commit engineering effort. Use AI tools to generate interactive mockups and working demos, and test ideas with stakeholders and users while they're still cheap to change.
- Turn AI-surfaced data into decisions, not just dashboards. Direct AI to analyze usage and product data and generate hypotheses; you decide what's worth an experiment and own the success metrics.
- Engage directly with customers and internal customer-facing teams. Bring product thought leadership and vision to sales, customer success, and BD conversations, and equip customer-facing teams with the product knowledge and direction they need.
- Raise the bar for how Product works with AI, building the prompts, templates, and guardrails other PMs reuse, and holding the team accountable for accuracy, bias, and privacy — especially with sensitive behavioral health and absence data.

##### Job Qualifications

- 5+ years owning products end to end — strategy, roadmap, and execution — not just a slice of someone else's.
- Deep technical acumen and a real partnership with Engineering, with enough command of system constraints and tradeoffs to make good calls without being told the answer.
- A backlog discipline you can defend: writing detailed stories, prioritizing under pressure, and unblocking a cross-functional team without becoming its bottleneck.
- An analytical, data-driven approach to problem-solving, with experience working in an Agile environment and driving initiatives through influence rather than authority.
- AI is already part of how you work, not something you're curious about. You use assistants like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research synthesis, PRD and story drafting, prototyping, or data analysis — and can point to outputs you caught before they shipped.
- Sound judgment about when to trust AI and when not to, including real awareness of hallucination risk, bias, and data-privacy considerations — especially with regulated or sensitive data.
- A track record of helping teams adopt new tools and ways of working. You don't just use AI well yourself — you raise the floor for everyone around you.

Bonus: experience in behavioral health, absence management, or another regulated, data-sensitive industry.

##### Compensation and Benefits

- Full benefits package, including Paid Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, robust EAP, wellness program, and much more

The actual compensation will be influenced by a wide range of factors including, but not limited to previous experience, education, pay market/geography, and scheduled hours.

##### Senior Product Manager

The Exposures product team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead complex, advanced, AI-heavy cybersecurity features across multiple disciplines from rollout to iterative learning loops. You will manage strategic initiatives, dive into technical details, and drive the strategy for Axonius's fastest-growing emerging product line, including a dedicated focus on building robust product compliance capabilities. In this role, you will collaborate with global engineering, cyber research, sales, and marketing teams to scale enterprise software solutions.

##### Responsibilities

- Define the product vision, build and maintain the product roadmap, and drive full-lifecycle execution for advanced, AI-heavy enterprise cyber features.
- Lead the end-to-end strategy, design, and product implementation for customer compliance modules (including frameworks such as ISO, SOC2, etc.).
- Work directly with enterprise customers to identify business needs, translate them into technical roadmap priorities, and optimize the customer experience.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Cyber Research, Sales, and Marketing teams to deliver scalable software products to the global market.

##### Minimum Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a B2B software environment.
- Proven professional background in Cybersecurity or Networking with demonstrated Domain Knowledge.
- Hands-on experience owning and executing compliance-focused product initiatives and framework integrations (e.g., ISO, SOC2) within previously delivered products.
- Demonstrated experience managing, designing, or implementing AI-heavy components or machine learning features.
- Full professional proficiency in English with a documented track record of presenting complex product strategies to technical and business stakeholders.

##### Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience deploying software products to market at enterprise scale.
- Professional experience managing Platform Products or building enterprise Asset Management and Data products.
- Strong technical background in software engineering, system architecture, or computer science.
- Demonstrated history of navigating complex, multi-variable customer risk and governance environments.
- Experience collaborating closely with dedicated cyber research and threat intelligence teams.

Axonius transforms cyber asset intelligence into actionability. With the Axonius Asset Cloud, customers preemptively tackle high-risk and hard-to-spot threat exposures, misconfigurations, and overspending. The integrated platform brings together data from every system in an organization's IT infrastructure to optimize mission-critical risk, performance, and cost measures via actionable intelligence.

Covering cyber assets, software, SaaS applications, identities, vulnerabilities, infrastructure, and more, Axonius is the one place to go for Security, IT, and GRC teams to continuously drive actionability across the organization. Cited as one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity startups, with accolades from CNBC, Forbes, and Fortune, Axonius supports millions of assets for leading customers across industries and around the world.

Axonius makes it a priority to invest in our people with competitive compensation and benefits, growth opportunities, community-building, and so much more. Learn more about benefits at Axonius.

At Axonius we support a diverse and inclusive workplace and believe in equal employment opportunity. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

##### The Role

Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take full ownership of a product area, guiding it from early research through launch and ongoing refinement. You will partner daily with engineers, designers and commercial colleagues, and this is a hands-on individual contributor position rather than a people management one.

##### What You'll Do

- **Lead a product area** from initial customer research through planning, release and follow-up improvements.
- Act as the link between engineering, design and business teams, translating user needs into clear specifications and informing technical design choices.
- **Create early working prototypes** with AI-assisted coding tools so engineers start from something tangible.
- Define measurable goals for each initiative and keep refining until targets are met.
- Collaborate with sales and customer success colleagues on positioning and on supporting active deals.
- Travel within the country to customer locations roughly monthly, with occasional added trips around major milestones.

##### What We're Looking For

- **5 to 10 years** in product management or a closely related discipline, such as forward-deployed engineering, as an individual contributor.
- Currently working as a founder or product manager, and in that position for at least 1 year.
- Background in business-focused subscription software at an early-stage or scaling company, with a history of delivering under tight resources and fast timelines.
- A track record of taking a brand-new product or capability from nothing to launch, beyond maintaining an existing backlog.
- Enough technical depth to build prototypes with AI-assisted tools, navigate source code and take part in design discussions.
- Hands-on work with external system connections and partner interfaces.
- Concise, clear written documentation that helps teams make decisions.
- Located in the United States and authorized to work without visa sponsorship.
- Willingness to travel domestically about once a month.

##### Bonus Points

- Prior work in a regulated sector such as financial services, insurance or healthcare.
- An earlier career in software engineering or customer-embedded engineering before moving into product.
- A technical university degree.
- Familiarity with large language model concepts and having released AI-driven functionality to users.
- Comfort with data analysis, building reports and using metrics to guide post-launch improvements.
- Experience as a startup founder.

##### Location and Work Model

- Remote (US)
- Full-time

##### Compensation, As The Posting Describes It

- Equity

# Senior Technical Product Manager

$175k

Going

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/923840889614507917?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2029652730419011255&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Technical Product Manager

At Going, data is our core product driver and a product in its own right. Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) is the team that runs it like an internal platform business: your product is the unified stream of flight data; your customers are our internal product and feature teams, and your ultimate end-users are millions of subscribers who rely on us for timely, hyper-relevant flight deals.

We're hiring a systems-thinking Senior Technical Product Manager to lead a cross-functional team of senior Data and Backend Engineers. You'll own the charter and roadmap for how Going acquires, pipelines, and engineers high-quality datasets that power Going's core products. This requires building the resilience and diversification that reduces our dependence on any single data source, and turning that data into a product every downstream team can build on without re-solving it themselves. You'll report to the VP of Product.

##### In The Short Term, You Will

- Take ownership of the product data acquisition strategy and data processing roadmap; supporting the parallel build of a new system to replace the current

- Establish baseline measurement across our data funnel — coverage, pipeline health, and data quality — so future architecture and business decisions are based on value and cost

- Drive architecture that enables efficiency — a single-record architecture that's durable and observable

- Make data usable, not just available — You'll push toward a dynamic system that learns and adapts based on market trends and real consumer demand

- Serve internal customers so downstream teams have one trusted source to build against


##### In The Long Term, You Will

- Build Going's long-term data acquisition strategy — diversified, cost-efficient, and resilient to any single vendor's disruption

- Turn our data caching and curation layer into a plug-and-play foundation that can onboard any future data source

- Make the data platform the compounding advantage behind Going's product — the thing every team builds on, not a shared dependency people work around


##### What You Know

**Required:**

- You're legally authorized to work in the United States and able to work US-hours.

- 5–8+ years of product management experience, with significant time owning data platform, data infrastructure, or data products

- Systems & Data Fluency: Comfort reading API specs, writing SQL, working with complex JSON/XML schemas, and discussing architecture (ETL/ELT pipelines, caching strategies, data lineage and provenance, metadata management) with senior engineers as peers

- Exposure to data quality, normalization, or golden dataset patterns

- Experience establishing measurement baselines before re-architecting or setting targets — you diagnose before you build

- Comfortable owning vendor/supplier relationships and contract negotiation, including cost-vs-coverage tradeoffs

- Track record navigating ambiguity while still shipping durable, well-governed systems

- Clear, async-first communicator — comfortable setting direction for a dedicated engineering team while working across technical and non-technical partners


**Preferred:**

- Travel/aviation data expertise: GDS feeds, OAG/Cirium APIs, fare buckets and cabin mapping, IATA/ICAO codes

- Prior experience designing internal data products or operating within a Data Mesh architecture.

- Experience with event-driven architectures, low-latency edge caching, and scaling systems for real-time demand spikes.


##### Benefits & Perks You'll Love…

- The salary for this role starts at $175,000 + equity

- 100% remote work environment

- Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City.

- Open vacation policy, with a 15-day minimum

- Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance

- 401(k) with a 5% match

- $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend

- Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave

- Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co-worker

- Continuing education & development reimbursement

- Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day


We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. ## Job Description Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Agents, Evals & Reliability, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Required, Work From Home We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. The Senior Technical Product Manager will work directly with engineers on systems design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. The Senior Technical Product Manager will work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) experience are required for this position. **This position is 100% Remote.** **MUST BE WILLING TO TAKE A 60 MINUTE CODING ASSESSMENT.** Senior Technical Product Manager Responsibilities: \- Research and define end-to-end Artificial Intelligence (AI) system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact. \- Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions. \- Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and User Experience (UX). \- Work closely with Machine Learning (ML), backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration. \- Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback. \- Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization. \- Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops. \- Own product quality end-to-end, including correctness, predictability, and user trust. Outcomes: \- Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities. \- Artificial Intelligence (AI) features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users. \- Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty. \- Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback. \- Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute Artificial Intelligence (AI) product goals with minimal friction.

## Qualifications

Senior Technical Product Manager Qualifications:

Technical Foundation:

\- Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

\- Solid understanding of Machine Learning (ML) fundamentals and how modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems behave in production.

\- Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning (ML) Experience:

\- Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems.

\- Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

\- Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

Product Leadership:

\- Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

\- Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and Machine Learning (ML) teams.

\- Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

\- Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

Nice to have:

\- Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

\- Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

\- Experience defining evaluation metrics for Machine Learning (ML) systems.

\- Strong intuition for Artificial Intelligence (AI) User Experience (UX) patterns and failure handling.

\- Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

##### Senior Technical Product Manager

The Treasury Digital Technology team is a pivotal function within GE Vernova, responsible for the architecture, deployment, and lifecycle management of the global treasury application portfolio. Our mission is to provide robust, scalable solutions that power the company's financial operations, including global payments, cash management, liquidity planning, investment monitoring, and risk exposure tracking. As a Senior Technical Product Manager, you will serve as the primary configuration owner for our core Treasury pillar applications—FIS Trax (Payment Hub) and FIS Quantum (Treasury Management System). You will lead the continuous optimization and configuration of our financial technology stack, drive system integrations, and ensure our platforms evolve to meet the needs of a dynamic global business.

Roles and Responsibilities

- Drive Voice of Customer (VOC) initiatives: gather requirements, facilitate feedback loops, and fine-tune product features to align with business needs.
- Work with cross-functional teams to deliver features in Trax and Quantum.
- Demonstrate ability to influence customers and product managers through persuasion and influencing.
- Manage the sprint backlog and short-term product roadmap to ensure consistent delivery of monthly releases.
- Engage frequently with the development team; facilitates discussions, provides clarification, story acceptance and refinement, testing and validation; contributes to design activities and decisions.
- Translate ambiguous business requirements into actionable user stories, technical specifications, and clear work units for development teams.
- Partner with Service Owners/Development Managers to ensure healthy and harmonized development process across the different applications PODS.
- Apply Agile Methodology and Lean tools

Education Qualification

- Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
- 5 to 8 years of experience in technical product management, software development, or a treasury-related systems role.

Desired Characteristics

- Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of software design and coding principles
- Experience working in an Agile environment
- Demonstrates knowledge on technical topics, such as APIs, data transfer, security, coding, databases.
- Business Acumen: Demonstrates interest in learning business treasury function and processes
- Demonstrates the initiative to explore alternate technology and approaches to solving problems
- Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements and estimating efforts
- Has the ability to analyze impact of technology choices
- Skilled in negotiation to align stakeholders and communicate a single synthesized perspective to the scrum team.
- Balances value propositions for competing stakeholders.
- Leadership: Influences through others; builds direct and "behind the scenes" support for ideas.
- Pre-emptively sees downstream consequences and effectively tailors influencing strategy to support a positive outcome.
- Able to verbalize what is behind decisions and downstream implications.
- Continuously reflecting on success and failures to improve performance and decision-making.
- Understands when change is needed.
- Participates in technical strategy planning.
- Personal Attributes: Able to effectively direct and mentor others in critical thinking skills.
- Proactively engages with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and design solutions using critical thinking and analysis skills and best practices.
- Finds important patterns in seemingly unrelated information.
- Influences and energizes others toward the common vision and goal.
- Maintains resilience and focus on the common vision, identifying pivot points and alternative strategies when faced with complex roadblocks.
- Innovates and integrates new processes and/or technology to significantly add value to GE Vernova.
- Identifies how the cost of change weighs against the benefits and advises accordingly.
- Proactively learns new solutions and processes to address seemingly unanswerable problems.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Description

Senior Technical Product Manager
Location: Hybrid (DC Metro Area Preferred)

Position Overview
Venesco is seeking a highly experienced Senior Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and lifecycle management of FDA-regulated medical products. Lead end-to-end product lifecycle management from concept through commercialization

Develop Target Product Profiles (TPPs) and long-term product strategies

Coordinate cross-functional teams including clinical, regulatory, CMC, and manufacturing

Mentor junior staff and support continuous process improvement initiatives

Advanced degree (MS, PhD, or PharmD) in life sciences or related discipline

10+ years of product development or technical product management experience

Experience supporting FDA-regulated products and regulatory submissions

Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or Agile certification

Experience supporting government or military health programs

Oliver Wyman

[Phoenix, AZ](https://jooble.org/jobs/Phoenix%2C-AZ)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3644944393046201699?p=1&pos=0&rgn=4605&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=9084826461505833413&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Lead Technical Product Manager

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Client Technology team, part of our Marsh Risk business at Marsh. This role will be based in Phoenix, Austin and New York. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

At Marsh we are dedicated to driving product success through innovation and collaboration. We are seeking a Senior Lead Technical Product Manager to join our team, playing a critical role in enhancing product functionality and delivering to the portfolio commitments.

What can you expect?

As a Senior Technical Product Manager supporting Marsh's Client Management Value Stream, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering the technology capabilities that underpin the end-to-end client lifecycle — from onboarding and agreement management to anniversary reviews, client data updates, and operational efficiency.

You'll work closely with business leaders, operations teams, engineers, and delivery partners to translate strategy into action, ensuring products and platforms are aligned to Marsh's ambition to become the Risk Advisor of the Future. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to bring diverse stakeholders together around a shared vision.

You can expect to:

- Lead delivery of high-impact technology initiatives that improve client servicing, streamline workflows, and enable better data quality and automation
- Partner with the business to understand priorities, define outcomes, and turn needs into clear product direction and delivery plans
- Collaborate across multiple teams to deliver solutions that support global scale, operational consistency, and improved client experience
- Help drive modernization across core client management capabilities, including onboarding, agreements, client profiles, and servicing processes
- Work in a fast-paced environment with significant visibility, where your contribution directly supports commercial outcomes and business growth
- Influence how Marsh uses technology, data, and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and create a more connected client experience

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys leading through influence, building trusted relationships, and making a tangible impact across a strategic business value stream.

We Will Count on You to:

- Partner with business leaders to create and executing a multi-year vision for their portfolio of applications. This vision includes a point-of-view on the future role of technology for that business or functional area (new technology requirements), application disposition, build versus buy, sequence in which new functionality will be developed (macro), modernization approach, application retirement, portfolio ROI planning etc.
- Clearly articulate product features with clarity and precision to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Lead product roadshows to showcase key functionalities and gather feedback, ensuring alignment across teams and customers. Create comprehensive documentation that clearly outlines product features and their value propositions, enabling effective communication and driving adoption.
- Manage portfolio budget and driving responsible development defined as on-time and on-budget development of new capabilities aligned to enterprise standards as well as appropriate ongoing management of those applications in partnership with MMC shared service leaders. Balancing CTB and RTB spend across the portfolio including planning around application lifecycle. e.g. when does an application move into'maintenance'.
- Proactively identify new technologies available in the marketplace to address specific business needs within their area of ownership so that technology can better serve as a strategic partner to the business. For instance, a TPM for placement at Marsh would be responsible for proactively identifying opportunities to add new features to existing solutions and bring those to the business.
- Create a single point of accountability for customizations or variations needed by geography, business line, or department with the goal of avoiding custom solutions that create excess complexity and increase MMC's cost burden.

What You Need to Have:

- Proven experience as a Technical Product Manager or in a similar role, with a strong understanding of product development and data strategy. Proven experience delivering technology initiatives successfully.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement and efficiency.

What Makes You Stand Out:

- Experience in developing and executing multi-year technology visions and portfolio ROI planning.
- Background in the insurance or financial services industry is a plus.
- Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience working in cross-functional teams.

Why join our team:

- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being

# Sr. Technical Product Manager

Taboola DACH

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1844858316659644987?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-323338636186035375&crId=US_0US_0)

About Connexity:
Connexity is the leading performance marketing technology company connecting the world's top retailers with high-intent shoppers. We power product discovery across a network of premium publishers, helping them monetize smarter and helping retailers drive measurable sales. We move fast, think in systems, and hold ourselves to a high bar on craft and outcomes.

The Role:
We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own two of the highest-leverage areas in our publisher business: the products our enterprise publishers rely on every day, and the monetization infrastructure that underpins the performance and trust of our entire ecosystem. This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. It's a role for someone who sees a complex, interconnected system (publisher relationships, tracking pipelines, monetization mechanics) and immediately starts identifying the highest-leverage points to improve it. You'll be expected to operate with the strategic clarity of a product leader and the rigor of someone who actually understands how systems work. You'll be accountable to both the business and the publishers who depend on what you build. We hire people who want to be challenged. If that's you, let's talk.

Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap

Own a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap; defend trade-offs with data and a clear point of view

Proactively identify and size opportunities through quantitative analysis, partner signals, and competitive intelligence

Define success metrics before a single line of code is written

Approach the roadmap with a build-to-learn mindset; favor fast, validated bets over long hidden development cycles

Structured Discovery & Technical Requirements

Engage directly with enterprise publishers to distinguish market problems from individual partner requests

Write PRDs and technical requirements (API contracts, data models, product experiences) that are unambiguous and implementation-ready

Partner with engineering on architecture, data pipeline design, technical trade-offs to generate product recommendations

Execution, Delivery, & Stakeholder Management

Drive the full product lifecycle: scoping, prioritization, sequencing, launch coordination, and post-launch analysis

Remove blockers proactively, escape with solutions, and bias toward action

Build deep relationships with enterprise publishers and internal stakeholders to translate market needs into scalable solutions

Lead cross-functional reviews, alignment meetings, and proactively communicate up, down, and across without losing fidelity

Team Development

Mentor junior and mid-level PMs on discovery quality, PRD precision, metrics discipline, and execution

Raise team standards by example - bring frameworks, challenge existing ones, and create an environment where people are pushed to grow

Requirements

5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex, technical products end-to-end

Ecommerce experience required - you understand the retail and shopping ecosystem, how performance-based models work, and what drives outcomes for merchants and publishers

Technical background strongly preferred - CS, engineering, data science, or equivalent demonstrated fluency; you don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in architectural conversations

Strong data instincts - you define leading product metrics (adoption, engagement, feature impact) before you ship and analyze results to drive your next decision

Experience with affiliate/performance monetization - you understand how affiliate networks, click tracking, and attribution models work

**This role is for one of our clients**

**Work Location:** Fairfield, CA (or) Southlake, Dallas

**Experience:** 5 to 7 years

**Base Salary -** USD $120,000 to $190,000

We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior Technical Product Manager** with strong technical depth and extensive experience in the **Energy & Utilities sector** , particularly within Electrical Power Transmission & Distribution. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, domain knowledge, and leadership capabilities to guide engineering teams and drive successful product development.

**Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer & Requirement Analysis**

- Engage with customers to understand their needs and translate them into clear functional, non-functional, and technical product requirements.
- Ensure that development teams have full clarity on requirements and that delivery plans align with expectations.

**Technical & Industry Expertise**

- Bring deep knowledge of the Electrical Power Transmission & Distribution industry to shape product direction and technical decisions.
- Stay informed about industry advancements, emerging technologies, and market trends.
- Perform ongoing competitive and technical capability assessments.

**Collaboration & Execution**

- Work closely with developers, engineers, architects, QA teams, and business operations such as product marketing and business analysts.
- Assess, document, and mitigate technical risks in partnership with architecture and engineering teams.
- Support the end-to-end product lifecycle, from planning to launch and post-release improvements.

**Product Enablement & Evangelism**

- Serve as a subject matter expert for internal teams and external stakeholders.
- Deliver technical product presentations, demos, and training for customers and internal teams.
- Support pre-sales efforts through technical engagements and solution demonstrations.

**Testing & Documentation**

- Coordinate beta testing programs, define success criteria, and ensure proper evaluation before product acceptance.
- Drive the creation, organization, and maintenance of comprehensive product documentation.

**What You Bring**

- Strong technical background with hands-on exposure to product engineering or product development.
- Extensive experience in the Energy & Utilities industry, especially within Power Transmission & Distribution.
- Ability to translate complex customer needs into structured product requirements.
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills with both technical and business teams.
- Strong communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience supporting sales and marketing teams through technical enablement.

Contract-to-Hire Opportunity

Responsibilities:

Senior Technical Product Manager (Forward Deployment Lead)

Lead product manager for forward-deployed engagements, responsible for bridging business needs, SI delivery teams, and enterprise platform capabilities.

Identify platform gaps, reusable patterns, and improvement opportunities emerging from field implementations, feeding learnings back into the Integrated Data Platform roadmap.

Establish and govern intake, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management processes for the forward deployment model.

##### Group Product Manager

At CluePoints, we're redefining how clinical trials are run. As the premier provider of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) and Data Quality Oversight software, we harness advanced statistics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of clinical trial data, helping life sciences organizations bring safer, more effective treatments to patients faster.

We're proud to be an ambitious, fast-growing technology scale-up with a dynamic and diverse international team representing more than 20 nationalities. Collaboration, flexibility, and continuous learning are part of our DNA. At CluePoints, you'll find a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and have fun along the way.

Guided by our values of Care, Passion, and Smart Disruption, we're united by a shared mission: to create smarter ways to run efficient clinical trials and deliver AI-powered insights that improve human outcomes worldwide.

##### Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

- Translate company strategy and Market Owner direction into actionable squad-level outcomes, owning the OKR cascade from domain strategy to squad goals.
- Own roadmap prioritisation and portfolio-level trade-off decisions, and remain accountable for domain-level business outcomes.
- Co-define the go-to-market approach for your domain with Market Owners, and hold the quality bar for enablement materials produced by your team.
- Represent the domain at leadership level and act as the escalation point for major product or customer issues.

##### Discovery, Metrics & Delivery Quality

- Set and maintain discovery standards across all squads in your domain; join discovery calls to challenge surface-level findings, deepen questions and surface edge cases and biases.
- Ensure success metrics are defined and used consistently across your portfolio, reviewing portfolio-level metric health and surfacing business risk before it becomes visible to leadership.
- Hold the team accountable to outcomes rather than velocity, coaching PMs away from output and feature-factory thinking.
- Ensure no feature ships without appropriate regulatory and quality consideration, applying GxP-aware standards consistently across the portfolio.

##### AI-First Ways of Working & Cross-Functional Partnership

- Coach PMs on AI-assisted ways of working, ensuring the team reviews and challenges AI-generated artefacts and does not revert to manual-first habits.
- Maintain a cohesive vision, goals and processes with peer GPMs; proactively align to avoid fragmentation of the PM practice and surface cross-domain dependencies early.
- Act as the voice of the customer in release planning, influencing release sequencing and validation priorities (advocating within release management and validation, not owning them).
- Act as the primary interface with Sales, Customer Engagement and Professional Services for your domain, ensuring consistent, high-quality enablement at launch.
- Ensure every PM on your team has sufficient direct customer access and remove blockers to continuous discovery.

##### Must Haves

• Proven product management experience at Product Manager level or above, with a track record of owning outcomes and metrics across discovery to delivery.

• Demonstrated people leadership: coaching, performance management and career development of Product Managers (or equivalent product practitioners).

• Strong discovery practice, with the ability to coach others and to use domain expertise to challenge findings.

• Experience translating strategy into squad-level outcomes, including OKR-based planning and portfolio-level prioritisation and trade-offs.

• Working knowledge of regulated software development (GxP and audit readiness) and the ability to apply regulatory and quality standards to product decisions.

• Practical AI fluency: comfortable working AI-first and coaching a team to review and challenge AI-generated specifications and artefacts.

•Credible stakeholder management with Market Owners, Strategy, Engineering, Sales and customer-facing teams, including senior leaders.

• Excellent communication skills, able to represent a domain at leadership level and to resolve messaging and positioning conflicts.

##### Nice To Haves

- Experience in clinical trials technology, risk-based quality management, or clinical data analytics.
- Experience recruiting and onboarding product talent, and building team standards that others reference.
- Experience co-defining go-to-market approaches with other key stakeholders from Strategy and commercial functions.
- Comfort credibly engaging with engineering on architecture and platform implications.
- Practical AI fluency: comfortable working AI-first and coaching a team to review and challenge AI-generated specifications and artefacts.

##### What We Offer – United Kingdom

- Private Medical Insurance through Vitality Health (full hospital cover, 24/7 GP, and therapy sessions)
- Group Critical Illness Cover with Aviva
- Life Insurance (death-in-service lump sum)
- Pension Scheme with 9% employer contribution via Scottish Widows
- Opportunities for professional development and sponsored certifications
- A hub-based hybrid model that blends flexibility with purpose — connecting teams through collaboration, learning, and a vibrant social culture.
