About GetInsured What started as the “Expedia” of health insurance, has grown to a market leading company that is transforming government IT infrastructures with our proven SaaS and AI technology. Our innovative approach to health insurance shopping and enrollment has expanded beyond exchanges, and we’re now reinventing the way states administer safety net programs such as Medicaid, SNAP (food stamps), childcare, and unemployment insurance. With our cutting‑edge technology, we’re helping agencies help more people, faster, and transform health care service delivery as we know it.
This role may involve access to sensitive, confidential, or regulated information. As a part of your role, you would be expected to handle such information responsibly and in accordance with the organization’s privacy, security, and data protection policies and procedures. Training specific to this role and the handling of sensitive, confidential, or regulated information is required.
By accepting this role, you acknowledge your responsibility to safeguard sensitive information, use company systems and data only for authorized business purposes, and adhere to established security practices including access control, data classification, and least‑privilege principles. You are required to comply with all applicable company policies, legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements governing the protection and appropriate use of information.
About The Role As a Group Product Manager, you will:
Research and understand client, market, and business needs and translate them into clear, written product requirements.
Use data to determine why and when certain product needs should be addressed.
Ensure the product is designed for ease of use, integration, security, and scalability.
Collaborate daily with engineering, operations, support, consulting, and other product managers – appreciating the diverse mix of teammates who make things happen.
Understand and negotiate technical implementation options with engineering and make decisions based on business needs.
Lead and participate in sprint planning, grooming, and daily stand‑ups to ensure a steady flow of work to the development team.
Drive continuous improvement through the strengthening of tools, skills, infrastructure, and process improvements required to achieve business objectives.
Assist in roadmap development, planning activities, support, and release management.
Serve as a subject matter expert to developers, support, and clients.
\*This is a senior level product management role to take ownership of end‑to‑end consumer facing flows.
Compensation And Benefits Competitive compensation - All In range of ($180,000-$200,000). (Please note that salary and compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, experience, performance and location.)
We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to: Health, Dental, Life, Disability, and Vision insurance
Healthcare spending or reimbursement accounts (HSA/FSA)
Retirement benefits (401k)
Paid time off
Holidays: 13 paid days per year
Education assistance or tuition reimbursement
Employee discounts for Gym memberships & commuting/travel assistance
Our Values We believe that working hard, when it is imbued with purpose, can and should be fun.
You’ll find we are a “can do” place where people work together and roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
Everyone has a voice; everyone’s ideas count, and everyone is respected.
We have built a company, as well as a community of friends and colleagues, with respect for each other.
Qualifications Basic Qualifications A minimum of 8-10 years' experience as a product manager designing SaaS software
Experience writing requirements, use cases, and acceptance criteria
Ability to analyze and use data in decision making and to evaluate results.
Ability to communicate with business and technical stakeholders effectively both verbally and in writing.
Team player with an ability to work cross‑functionally and with remote teams and to influence clients and team members without formal authority.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including presentation and meeting facilitation skills.

# Group Product Manager - Aurora, IL

$135k - $145k

Mitutoyo America Corporation in

[Aurora, IL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Aurora%2C-IL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2597192333756787891?p=1&pos=0&rgn=54124&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8401130790779909657&crId=US_0US_0)

Mitutoyo America Corporation is seeking an experienced Group Product Manager to lead our Product Management team and help drive the growth and market success of our product portfolio.

This is a highly collaborative leadership position for someone who combines product management expertise, business acumen, market insight, and people leadership . You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Technical Support, Customer Support, Purchasing & Planning, and Mitutoyo's global teams to bring new products and solutions to market, strengthen competitive positioning, and turn strategic initiatives into actionable business results.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and develop the Product Management team, including performance management, training, work assignments, and succession planning.

Help develop and execute business plans, product strategies, growth initiatives, and market development programs.

Lead cross-functional launches of new products, software, and solutions.

Drive market research, competitive intelligence, market-share analysis, and pricing recommendations.

Partner with Sales leadership on pricing, promotions, product positioning, and growth opportunities.

Collaborate with Marketing to develop product messaging, launch materials, digital content, and product stories.

Oversee product training and sales-enablement resources for Sales, Technical Support, and other internal teams.

Monitor product launches, promotions, and campaign performance and recommend actions based on results.

Support inventory planning and demonstration product requirements in partnership with Sales and Purchasing & Planning.

Maintain accurate product information, pricing resources, and competitive intelligence.

Utilize approved AI, automation, and analytical tools to improve market research, competitive analysis, content development, and Product Management productivity.

These responsibilities reflect the position's emphasis on commercialization, market intelligence, pricing, training, product launches, and cross-functional execution.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field .

Minimum of 7 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or a related discipline.

3 years of leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

Experience leading product launches and cross-functional initiatives .

Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and decision-making skills.

Demonstrated ability to lead and develop employees while managing multiple business priorities.

Ability to develop strong working relationships across technical, sales, marketing, and operational teams.

Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

What Will Help You Succeed
The ideal candidate is business-minded, results-driven, innovative, and collaborative . You should be comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution, using market and competitive information to make informed recommendations, and helping your team translate product strategy into measurable results.

This position reports to the Director of Growth & Market Development .

Why choose Mitutoyo?
Mitutoyo America Corporation is a leader in the field of precision measuring tools and instruments. We serve an important role in providing state-of-the-art measurement products to manufacturing companies throughout North America. We are the only full-line provider of Metrology solutions in North America that can satisfy every measurement challenge faced by our customers. Our benefits include:

Competitive Salary package - $135K - $145K annually

Minimum 17 days PTO plus at least 10 paid holidays per year

Shut down period at the end of the year

STD, LTD, Employee Assistance Program

Tuition Reimbursement

Service Recognition

Company Vacation House in Florida

# Lead Product Manager, Claims Automation

$200k - $220k

Full-time

Sidecar Health

[California](https://jooble.org/jobs/California)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-629852468867269938?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=9102994654036454665&crId=US_0US_0)

Sidecar Health is redefining health insurance. Our mission is to make excellent healthcare affordable and attainable for everyone. We know that to accomplish this lofty mission, we need driven people who will make things happen.

The passionate people who make up Sidecar Health’s team come from all over, with backgrounds as tech leaders, policy makers, healthcare professionals, and beyond. And they all have one thing in common—the desire to fix a broken system and make it more personalized, affordable, and transparent.

If you want to use your talents to transform healthcare in the United States, come join us!

**_\*\*Must reside in California for consideration, This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or transfers.\*_**

**About the Role**

As a Lead Product Manager for claims automation at Sidecar Health, you will own critical claims platform features and systems that marry artificial intelligence and deterministic systems to power end to end claim processing, from the moment the data enters our system through claim finalization and payout. You'll drive the strategy, development, and launch of AI-powered features — including agentic systems, intelligent assistants, and human-in-the-loop experiences — that ensure claims are processed quickly and correctly.

You bring a builder's mindset with a passion for automation and complex problems. You understand how to design for trust and auditability in non-deterministic systems and know when deterministic systems are the best approach. You can think big in a systems view while diving into the details.

**What You'll Do**

- Own product strategy and roadmap for claims automation — spanning data extraction/entry, enrichment, identification, adjudication and routing across our claims processing platform
- Become an expert on our operational processes and map them to technology and software solutions.
- Define where AI/ML capabilities (document extraction, classification, sub-classification, routing) should be applied within the claims pipeline, and where logic should remain deterministic and rules-based
- Define evaluation frameworks for AI product quality — accuracy, safety, hallucination risk, auditability, and user trust — and use them to make ship/no-ship decisions
- Design human-in-the-loop workflows, audit trails, and escalation paths appropriate for a regulated, financial-transaction system
- Define quality and turnaround-time (TAT) metrics for automated and semi-automated claims workflows, and use them to make ship/no-ship and rollout decisions
- Drive build vs. buy decisions for claims infrastructure (e.g., pricing data, vendor tooling, etc) and make the call with clear tradeoff reasoning
- Lead a cross-functional pod of engineers, designers, and data scientists to ship high-impact improvements
- Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives — system migrations, platform upgrades, new payer/vendor integrations — from discovery through launch
- Navigate compliance-driven requirements (e.g., No Surprises Act and other regulatory constraints) and translate them into clear, buildable product requirements
- Partner closely with engineering, claims operations SMEs, and compliance stakeholders to scope initiatives, define MVPs, and sequence a heavily interdependent roadmap
- Write clear, detailed PRDs and specs that hold up under scrutiny from engineering, compliance, and executive stakeholders
- Use data and experimentation to measure the performance of automated workflows and continuously improve accuracy and throughput
- Establish and evolve product practices suited to a platform that is part infrastructure, part intelligent system
- Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape and translate emerging capabilities into concrete product opportunities
- Establish strong product practices tailored to the unique challenges of shipping AI products
- Set ambitious goals and hold yourself accountable

**What You'll Bring**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field
- 5+ years of product management experience working on processing systems with workflows, queues, routing, and automation.)
- Demonstrated experience taking AI products from concept through launch, including managing the unique challenges of non-deterministic systems — evaluation, safety, prompt design, user trust
- Deep understanding of AI agents and agentic architectures — you've shipped systems where AI takes sequences of actions, not just generates responses
- Experience defining AI product quality metrics beyond traditional A/B testing
- Strong instincts for designing auditable, traceable systems — this role sits inside financial-transaction and regulatory workflows where "mostly right" isn't sufficient without a clear audit trail
- Strong sense of design and UX, especially for data dense applications and interactions
- Demonstrated ability to write clear, rigorous specs for both deterministic systems (data pipelines, integrations, migrations) and non-deterministic ones (classification, extraction, routing logic), including how you evaluate and gain confidence in each
- Experience partnering with engineering on build vs. buy vs. integrate decisions, including vendor evaluation
- Proficiency in SQL for independent data analysis
- Deep understanding of Agile methodology
- Ability to manage a large number of interdependent workstreams and communicate sequencing tradeoffs to engineering, ops, and executive stakeholders
- Experience working cross-functionally across engineering, operations, compliance, and business stakeholders
- Claims processing, health insurance, or other regulated financial-transaction domain experience is a plus, but not required — we're equally interested in strong platform PMs from other complex domains
- Startup 0-to-1 builder experience is a strong plus — we want people who've shipped under constraints and learned from real users

**What You'll Get**

- Competitive salary, bonus opportunity, and equity package
- Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
- A 401k retirement plan
- Paid vacation and company holidays
- Opportunity to make an impact at a rapidly growing mission-driven company transforming healthcare in the U.S.

_In taking a market-based approach to compensation, base pay may vary depending on location. Additionally, base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related skills and experience. The current expected salary range for this position is: $200,000 - $220,000._

Code for America believes government can work for the people, by the people, in the new digital age, and that government at all levels can and should work well for all people. For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions.

Our employees build and transform government and community tools and services, making them so good they inspire change. We merge the best parts of technology, nonprofit, and government to help support the people who need it most.

With a focus on transparency and fairness, and deep empathy for partners in government and community organizations and the people that our partners serve, we’re building a movement of motivated change agents driven by meaningful results and lasting impact.

At Code for America, you contribute to exciting work while learning and developing in a supportive and flexible environment. Our compensation and benefits are holistic and thoughtfully curated to represent our employees and our mission. Help us drive real generational change that lasts.

Code for America is looking for a talented **Lead Product Manager** who will drive meaningful outcomes for the people and government partners we serve through our Safety Net, Tax Benefits, Criminal Justice products and/or rapid response work.

When building Code for America products, you'll develop meaningful products for individuals across the country, making it easier to access critical benefits and services, while also helping agencies deliver better digital services to the public in a way that lasts.

## **About the role:**

As a lead Product Manager at Code for America, you will set product direction and strategy for a product or project and lead a cross-functional team in delivering it. You’ll solve complex problems and deliver user-centered products and services, drawing on deep expertise in product management, stakeholder management, agile delivery and modern software development. You’ll work across the matrix: day to day with your project team and program partners, and within the Product discipline to grow shared practices.

This role will report to the **Director of Product** and is expected to travel no more than **15%** of the time.

Code for America is based in California and can employ those who reside full-time within the United States. This is a remote position.

## **In this position you will:**

- **Product strategy and direction**
 - Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for your product or project.
 - Partner with your program lead and cross-disciplinary team members to define the overall strategy for your project.
 - Make tradeoff decisions that balance user needs, partner expectations, scope and timeline within your project.
- **Stakeholder alignment**
 - Communicate product vision and strategy clearly to your team and internal stakeholders.
 - Drive alignment with government partners and other external stakeholders on product vision and strategy, partnering with program and other discipline colleagues as needed.
 - Contribute to scoping future opportunities in your product area in partnership with program leads.
- **Delivery and team leadership**
 - Lead a multidisciplinary team (which may include design, research and engineering) to test and deliver solutions that work for the people who need them most.
 - Work with fellow product managers and discipline leads to make sure your project delivers on its strategy and advances Code for America’s goals.
 - Identify and escalate risks with program and discipline leads, and determine mitigation strategies.
 - Develop and refine team processes with engineering and other leads so the team can focus on the right work and deliver efficiently.
 - Mentor other product managers and establish strong product practices within your team.
 - Model constructive communication: listen actively, give and receive feedback directly, address disagreements within the team promptly, and make space for differing perspectives.

You are an AI-first product thinker, comfortable applying automation and AI to solve meaningful customer and operational challenges. You bring strong product judgment, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the ability to balance user needs, regulatory complexity, and business outcomes.

In this role, you'll operate at the intersection of product strategy, execution, and cross-functional leadership. You'll drive complex initiatives in partnership with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams. Strong ownership, clear communication, and the ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders are essential to success.

##### Key Responsibilities

- Own the product vision and strategy for either the Hire & Onboard or Benefits domain, aligned with company goals and customer outcomes.

- Lead discovery and prioritisation across hiring and onboarding problems, balancing new features, regulatory needs, tech debt, and operational improvements.

- Translate strategy into execution, defining clear roadmaps, outcomes, and success metrics.

- Partner closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions with strong user experience.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Legal/Compliance and Go-to-Market to ensure feasibility and alignment.

- Represent the Hire & Onboard or Benefits domain in senior stakeholder forums, clearly communicating trade-offs, progress, risks, and impact.

- Identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve hiring and onboarding outcomes, efficiency, and decision-making.

- Use data and insights (quantitative and qualitative) to inform decisions, measure impact, and continuously improve outcomes.

- Ensure regulatory and compliance requirements are embedded into product development without compromising usability or speed.

- Continuously improve product processes, contributing to best practices across the wider Product organisation.


##### Core Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with a strong track record of owning complex product areas end-to-end and driving measurable business and customer outcomes.

- 3+ years of experience in HR tech, hiring, onboarding, benefits, payroll, compliance, or B2B SaaS, with a solid understanding of regulated or operationally complex domains.

- Strong product discovery and problem-framing skills, with the ability to deeply understand customer pain points, validate assumptions, and translate insights into impactful product solutions.

- You have a demonstrable capability for original thinking, and have great examples of how you have understood and solved a problem from first principles.

- You are a builder, and can demonstrate you have actively worked with AI-prototyping tools and used them to gain valuable feedback from users

- Hands-on experience building or iterating on AI-powered and automation-driven features, including defining use cases, evaluating trade-offs, and measuring real-world impact.

- Highly data-driven, comfortable using qualitative and quantitative insights to inform prioritisation, measure success, and continuously improve outcomes.

- Experience working in multinational, cross-functional environments, collaborating effectively across Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Go-To-Market teams.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset and the ability to bring clarity and structure to complex or evolving problem spaces.

- Strong standards for quality, ethics, and transparency, particularly when building products that impact people, employment, and compliance.

- Proven experience in scale-up or high-growth environments, with the ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term sustainability.


You'll also need

- A reliable home internet connection (or be able to get one)

- Fluent English language skills

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. ##### Hims & Hers Job Opportunity

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we're making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

##### About the Role:

Hims & Hers is at an inflection point. We've built dozens of categories that people love, and we're great at the treatments themselves. But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships. The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.

That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation. Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.

This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

##### You Will:

- Own the end-to-end consumer experience for this new relationship-first offering, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing engagement
- Define the synthesis layer across our existing categories, and stand up the new product lines the offering needs
- Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the consumer experience
- Partner with our clinical teams so protocols, safety, and education are core to the product experience
- Shape short- and long-term roadmaps, driving long-term scalability while balancing day-to-day improvements
- Operate with focus in a fast-growing, constantly evolving environment, where there are always more opportunities than resources

##### You Have:

- 6+ years of product management experience, working collaboratively across cross-functional teams
- A track record of building and shipping consumer products that customers love and that drive meaningful business impact
- A strong, specific point of view on where AI can meaningfully reshape the consumer healthcare experience, and the excitement to build it into the core of the product
- Fluency with AI agents and AI-native workflows. AI-native is your default operating mode: you work with agents the way most PMs work with docs, fluently and constantly
- Strategic and tactical range: you can set the vision and also design and execute scalable processes from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment
- Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you. This is a fully remote role, so clear written communication and proactive collaboration matter
- Bonus: experience in health, wellness, or category-defining 0-to-1 products

- Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

**Tripledot** **Studios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot's guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we're just getting started.

**This role sits within our Peoplefun studio.**

PeopleFun is an award-winning creator of mobile games for players across the globe. We are a Dallas-based game studio founded and maintained by game industry veterans, where game developers thrive on collaboration, creativity, teamwork and fun. Our games are played by over 25 million players each month, and we have a number of exciting mid-core and casual games in development. **Job Summary**

PeopleFun is seeking a Lead Product Manager to help shape the next chapter of Wordscapes, our flagship word game with more than 100M Google Play downloads. This role will own product strategy for a proven live game and identify the experiences and systems that will keep it growing.

You will lead the LiveOps pod, own and prioritize the LiveOps roadmap, and shape a sustainable cadence of features, events, content, offers, and experiments. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, hands-on analysis, and the ability to balance near-term performance with long-term player value.

**Responsibilities**

- Own product management for Wordscapes and lead the cross-functional pod responsible for the game's roadmap, execution, and performance.
- Drive sustainable growth by improving recurring engagement, retention, and monetization across the player lifecycle.

- Own key game KPIs and use player, cohort, funnel, segment, event, and feature data to identify opportunities and make product decisions.
- Partner with Design, Production, Engineering, and Analytics to deliver features, events, content, offers, and experiments with clear goals, success metrics, and guardrails.
- Own and evolve the game economy, progression systems, rewards, and offers to support player motivation, retention, monetization, and long-term game health.
- Review event and feature performance, identify follow-up actions, and apply learnings to future LiveOps cycles and roadmap decisions.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's Degree (graduate degree preferred) in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in game product management, ideally on a scaled free-to-play mobile game or long-running live product.
- Proven experience owning LiveOps for a free-to-play game and improving retention, engagement, or monetization through recurring events, content, offers, or features.
- Experience owning a product roadmap and leading a cross-functional team through strategy, execution, measurement, and follow-through.
- Strong understanding of free-to-play business models, LiveOps, game economies, and monetization systems.
- Highly data-driven, with the ability to analyze cohorts, funnels, segments, and experiments and translate insights into product decisions.
- Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including defining hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, and follow-up actions.
- Strong prioritization, initiative, judgment, and communication skills, with the ability to make clear decisions as information and priorities evolve.
- Ability to travel to the Dallas office 3-4 times per year.

- Time Off: Flexible Discretionary Time Off policy in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year.
- Financial: Generous 401k match, discretionary bonuses, and competitive salaries.
- Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage.

- Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development.

$180k - $210k

Gyde.ly

About Us

Insurance brokers sit at the intersection of care, cost, and access — yet remain one of the most underleveraged assets in the $5T healthcare value chain. They guide millions of Americans through plan selection, coverage questions, and care navigation, yet still rely on spreadsheets, manual workflows, and outdated tools that limit their growth and impact.

Gyde is reimagining this. We’re building the first AI-native insurance brokerage platform—a system that learns from every client interaction to automate operations, power intelligent voice and chat experiences, and predict the right coverage and products for every individual or business.

Our approach combines acquisition and AI: we acquire traditional brokerages and transform them into next-generation, data-driven organizations. Through Gyde’s platform, agencies run more efficiently, serve clients more personally, and scale faster than ever before.

Join us if you’re excited to:

Redefine how millions of people access and understand their healthcare coverage, by building systems that turn unstructured data, human conversations, and fragmented processes into intelligence.

Build AI systems that improve how people access healthcare

Design production‑grade voice, chat, and predictive models for a highly regulated domain

Launch technologies that augment human judgment and make complex decisions transparent and scalable

Help reinvent an entire industry from the inside out

We’re creating the future of brokerage — where every interaction, insight, and decision is powered by intelligence.

Our founding team boasts pedigrees from Oscar, Stripe, Vista Equity Partners, and Alpine. Lightspeed led Gyde’s $60M financing, with participation from Optum Ventures, Crystal Venture Partners, Virtue, MVP Ventures, and multiple endowment funds, among others. Hear why on LSVP Investment Memo.

Role Summary
We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to own key areas of our AI agent portfolio — production voice and SMS agents that handle real client conversations across the insurance lifecycle for the agencies we acquire. You'll report to the Head of Product and operate as a senior, hands‑on individual contributor with direct accountability for outcomes.

As an early product hire, you will carry broad ownership rather than a fixed surface area, and your focus will evolve with the roadmap. You will be responsible for taking AI agents from concept through production, adoption, and measurable revenue impact in a CMS‑regulated, high‑stakes domain.

Key Responsibilities

Set the product strategy and roadmap for your area of the agent portfolio, and evolve it as the market and our learnings shift.

Take conversational AI agents from concept through production launch, adoption, and measurable revenue impact.

Own prioritization for your area — what ships, what waits, and what we don't build.

Define what "good" means for every agent — call success rubrics, eval coverage, escalation behavior, zero‑tolerance compliance — and drive the improvement loop with engineering.

Translate broker, agency operator, and client insight into the roadmap, spending real time in the field (~25% travel) and validating with fast proof‑of‑concepts before committing engineering time.

Define success metrics for every initiative and tie them to revenue per broker.

Align founders, engineering, design, and partner success around direction, scope, and sequencing — communicating strategy and progress clearly, from working sessions to leadership reviews.

You nay be a good fit if you

Have 8+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years shipping AI/ML‑powered products to production — ideally in a regulated or workflow‑heavy domain

Have a demonstrated record of owning product strategy and roadmaps end‑to‑end — from vision through launch and iteration.

Are fluent in how LLM products are built and improved — evals, prompt iteration, quality/latency/cost trade‑offs — enough to earn engineers' trust.

Have a track record of defining metrics and designing experiments to drive product decisions, balanced with strong qualitative customer insight.

Use AI tools daily to prototype, test, and validate concepts.

Are hands‑on by default — you listen to the calls, read the transcripts, and write the first draft yourself.

Would rather ship a scoped V1 that generates signal than a complete V3 that doesn't.

Have a point of view on how AI agents will change insurance distribution — and want to test it in production.

Communicate exceptionally and drive alignment without relying on authority.

Strong candidates may also have: experience with voice AI or telephony products; Medicare/ACA or adjacent insurance domain knowledge; early or founding PM experience.

Gyde offers a competitive benefits package to all employees.

OTE: $180,000 - 210,000

Flexible (Unlimited) Paid Time Off

Hybrid Work in Austin, TX or New York, NY

Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K)

Parental Leave

PeopleGrove builds software that helps higher education institutions support students and graduates at every stage of their journey — from experiential learning to career outcomes. The Role We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and drive product strategy across PeopleGrove's CORE platform — a suite of products that includes ELMS (experiential learning management for Nursing and Education), CompMS (competency management), MyCred (digital credentials), and more.
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of complex domain expertise, accreditation compliance, and modern product thinking. You'll work closely with engineering, design, customer success, and senior stakeholders to define what gets built, why, and when — and you'll be the connective tissue between user needs and scalable product decisions.

Comfort working in a distributed, async-first environment with a globally distributed team

Curiosity, rigor, and a bias toward outcomes over output

Nice to Have Familiarity with clinical placement, competency-based education, or accreditation reporting workflows

Prior experience at a growth-stage edtech or vertical SaaS company

Small, senior team — your work shapes the product meaningfully

Fully remote with a collaborative, low-ego culture

Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

Identify and operationalize common patterns across customers and implementations to improve product reuse, reduce one-off customization, and accelerate delivery quality and speed.
Lead the definition of complex workflows, data needs, business rules, and integration points across internal and external systems.
Shape roadmap and investment decisions by balancing user value, strategic differentiation, delivery leverage, technical constraints, and long-term scalability.
Create and maintain high-quality product artifacts such as requirements, workflow definitions, prioritization frameworks, templates, and playbooks that improve execution across teams.
Use product, operational, market, customer, and user insights to evaluate performance, inform iteration, and continuously improve the product experience and business impact.
Partner with GTM, Delivery, and Partner Success to strengthen demos, scoping, positioning, and customer-facing product communication.
Act as a senior product leader and trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, helping teams navigate ambiguity, make decisions, and stay aligned on outcomes.

Technical & Interoperability: High-level understanding of modern healthcare data architectures, mobile-first design for frontline workflows, and interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, EHR/EDW integrations).
Cross-Functional Execution: Proven authority in bridging R&D, Delivery, and Go-To-Market teams. Skilled at setting execution standards, building high-impact playbooks, and coaching cross-functional teams through ambiguity.
Strategic & Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to balance strategic differentiation, technical constraints, user value, and commercial viability to prioritize investments and drive measurable business impact.
Nice to Have Qualifications Advanced degree (MS, MBA, or clinical degree) or relevant technical/clinical background.
Prior experience establishing product management standards, frameworks, and playbooks across a growing product organization.
Direct experience leading crisis response, care coordination, or time-sensitive mobile workflows in healthcare ecosystems.

# Senior Lead Product Manager

Lumen

[Richmond, VA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Richmond%2C-VA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7395071523189868910?p=1&pos=0&rgn=2986&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2138505384519075211&crId=US_0US_0)

The Role

The Senior Lead Product Manager, Market Strategy & Investment Planning will identify, size, and prioritize market expansion opportunities across the Infrastructure Products portfolio. This role will connect market demand with network feasibility and investment economics to guide where Lumen should expand, modernize, or deploy capital.

The Main Responsibilities

Develop and maintain product and geographic market sizing, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM).

Analyze market demand, customer concentration, competitive dynamics, growth trends, network reach, and infrastructure readiness.

Create a consistent market-attractiveness framework to stack rank metros, routes, and other expansion opportunities.

Partner with Network Planning to assess capacity, build feasibility, deployment timing, and network alternatives.

Build investment cases that quantify revenue potential, margin, capital requirements, time to revenue, payback, and strategic value.

Recommend portfolio and capital priorities to Product, Network Planning, Finance, and senior leadership.

Maintain decision-ready dashboards and executive materials, and track approved investments against expected market and financial outcomes.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in product management, market strategy, network planning, corporate strategy, finance, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience with market sizing, segmentation, financial modeling, business cases, or investment prioritization.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert complex market and network data into clear recommendations.

# Senior Product Owner

Full-time

Tria Federal

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3272902123842548239?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=210&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2523741501761058612&crId=US_0US_0)

**Who we are:**

Tria Federal delivers digital services and technology solutions that support the health and safety of veterans, service members and civilians. For two decades, federal agencies have relied on Tria companies to advance their critical missions and modernize their systems, so that they can uphold their commitment to the American people. Today, we are pushing the boundaries of possibility through partnerships and investments in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, developing solutions for the biggest challenges that government will face tomorrow.

**We are proud to employ and support military veterans** who bring mission-first mindset, technical expertise, and leadership qualities that strengthen our work. **Veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Job Description:**

Tria is seeking a **Senior Product Owner** to support the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Quality Payment Program (QPP) contract, with responsibility for the Self-Nomination, Targeted Review, and Electronic Prescribing for Controlled Substances (EPCS) teams. This role connects CMS policy and business priorities with the day-to-day delivery of reliable, usable digital services for clinicians, third-party intermediaries, prescribers, and CMS staff.

The Senior Product Owner will own and prioritize team backlogs, translate complex requirements into actionable work, and coordinate delivery across teams and contractors. Working with CMS business owners and QPP product leadership, this person will balance annual program deadlines, user needs, operational issues, and long-term product improvements.

**Basic Requirements:**

- Ability to successfully obtain a U.S. Federal Position of Trust (Public Trust) designation.
- Must reside in and be able to perform work in the United States.
- Must have lived in the United States for 3 of the last 5 years.
- Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience delivering software through Agile teams, including substantial experience as a product owner, product manager, business analyst, or product analyst.
- Demonstrated experience owning product backlogs, setting priorities with stakeholders, and developing user stories and acceptance criteria using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
- 3+ years of experience with healthcare IT programs, including healthcare data, business processes, and policy-driven requirements.

**Additional Qualifications:**

- Experience supporting CMS or other federal healthcare IT programs; familiarity with QPP and the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) is preferred.
- Familiarity with Qualified Clinical Data Registry (QCDR) and Qualified Registry self-nomination, MIPS targeted review, or CMS EPCS compliance and waiver processes is preferred.
- Ability to interpret policy and program guidance, identify system impacts, and resolve requirements questions with policy and business subject matter experts.
- Experience coordinating multiple teams and contractors, managing dependencies, and explaining priorities and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to facilitate decisions when requirements are incomplete or competing priorities arise.
- Experience with human-centered design, business process modeling, and using research, support trends, and product data to guide improvements.
- Working knowledge of APIs, data flows, system integrations, Section 508 accessibility, and security and privacy considerations in federal digital services.
- Experience with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe); Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or comparable certification is a plus.

**Responsibilities:**

- Own and prioritize backlogs for the Self-Nomination, Targeted Review, and EPCS teams in alignment with CMS priorities, QPP product direction, user needs, and delivery capacity.
- Partner with CMS business owners and QPP product leadership to define product goals, maintain roadmaps, and balance policy commitments, operational support, technical debt, and enhancements.
- Support Self-Nomination capabilities for QCDRs and Qualified Registries, including application submission, CMS review workflows, and related QCDR measure submissions.
- Support Targeted Review capabilities that allow QPP participants to request CMS review of participation status, MIPS final scores, and related payment adjustments, including request intake and review workflows.
- Support CMS EPCS capabilities for prescribers to view compliance information and submit waiver applications, along with the workflows CMS staff use to review and manage those applications.
- Translate CMS policy, annual program changes, and stakeholder needs into features, user stories, business rules, and testable acceptance criteria. Confirm policy interpretations with CMS and appropriate subject matter experts.
- Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, demonstrations, and Program Increment planning. Clarify requirements throughout development and evaluate completed work against acceptance criteria.
- Coordinate dependencies with identity and access, eligibility, scoring, data, and other shared services as applicable. Assess downstream impacts and align work across teams and contractors.
- Work with human-centered design, engineering, and quality assurance teams to improve end-to-end workflows, including form usability, accessibility, validation, status visibility, and error handling.
- Partner with quality assurance and business stakeholders on acceptance testing and release readiness, including program-year transitions and time-sensitive application and review periods.
- Investigate production issues and support trends with engineering, operations, and the service desk. Prioritize fixes based on user impact, program deadlines, and risk.
- Coordinate with policy, communications, training, and support partners so guidance and operational procedures reflect released functionality and program requirements.
- Define and monitor product outcomes, such as application completion, processing time, error rates, and support volume. Use findings to prioritize improvements and report progress, risks, and decisions.

**Why Tria?**

What defines the Tria brand is more than just our dedication to excellence in our craft; it’s our incredible team of dedicated, talented, and passionate people that make Tria so exceptional. As people powering possible, we are all partners in our team’s shared success.

As a company that cares about people, we seek to cultivate a culture in which all can thrive personally _and_ professionally. We offer a top-tier benefits package to invest in your physical, mental, and financial health and wellness so that you can be your best self - at work _and_ in life. At Tria, we are growth-minded, entrepreneurial in spirit, and committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and opportunity for all. Whatever your background, your role, your department, or stage in your professional journey, here you will have opportunities to learn new skills, seize new challenges, and advance your career as we grow.

# AI Product Owner (Manager/Senior Manager)

$160k - $190k

Full-time

MENARINI Group

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-183910945816378217?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=282&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1235179718351901425&crId=US_0US_0)

**Company:** 0750 Stemline Therapeutics Inc

**Contract Type:**

Permanent

**Join us in shaping the future of Menarini - with passion, integrity, and a deep commitment to people.**

About Menarini Group - Menarini is a leading international biopharmaceutical company committed to advancing health through innovation, research, and quality. For more than 135 years, we have worked to improve patients’ lives across a broad range of therapeutic areas through our dedication to science, integrity, and care for people. With a strong foundation in scientific excellence and a purpose-driven culture, Menarini offers diverse career opportunities for professionals eager to make a meaningful impact on global health.

Position Title: IT AI Product Owner

Reports to: Head of AI Engineering

Our company is seeking an IT AI Product Owner to support the operation and continuous improvement of our AI-enabled business solutions/products, with a specific focus on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — the discipline of ensuring company brands, products, and scientific content are accurately represented, discoverable, and favorably surfaced across AI-driven search and answer engines (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and similar generative platforms). This role sits at the intersection of IT operations, and business function teams such as digital marketing/communications, and content governance, and requires someone comfortable working across technical systems, business stakeholders, and compliance requirements unique to the life sciences industry.

The ideal candidate will combine solid technical/business analysis skills with curiosity about the evolving generative AI search landscape, and will be comfortable owning a recurring monitoring cadence, translating findings into actionable recommendations, and partnering with Marketing, Medical/Regulatory, and IT teams to keep company content accurate and optimized.

This position may be eligible for remote consideration; however, please see "Convenience of the Employer" statement below.

**What Success Looks Like**

- AI solution incidents and enhancement requests are resolved efficiently, with strong stakeholder satisfaction.
- A consistent, well-documented GEO monitoring cadence is in place, surfacing issues before they become reputational or compliance risks.
- Content updates driven by GEO insights are implemented on schedule and demonstrably improve the accuracy and visibility of company assets in AI-generated answers.
- IT, Marketing, Medical, and Regulatory teams view this role as a trusted, proactive partner on AI and digital content matters.

Business Translation & Agile Backlog Management:

- Translation of complex, unstructured business workflows and strategic goals into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and system requirements that IT and engineering teams can immediately execute within an Agile/Scrum environment.
- Serve as day-to-day operational support for internal AI solutions/tools (e.g., generative AI writing assistants, chatbots, internal copilots, AI-enabled analytics platforms), monitoring performance, availability, and adoption.
- Triage and resolve or escalate incidents, access requests, and configuration issues related to AI platforms in partnership with IT infrastructure, vendors, and business owners.
- Support governance activities including AI tool intake, risk/compliance reviews, and maintenance of an AI use-case inventory.
- Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), release notes, and training materials for AI solution updates and rollouts.

GEO Monitoring & Analysis

- Conduct regular (weekly/monthly) monitoring of how company brands, products, pipeline assets, and scientific/medical content appear across generative AI search and answer engines.
- Track accuracy, completeness, sentiment, and citation sources of AI-generated responses referencing company assets; flag misinformation, outdated data, or off-label/non-compliant representations for immediate escalation.
- Benchmark company visibility in AI-generated answers against competitors and industry standards; maintain a GEO scorecard/dashboard of findings and trends over time.
- Stay current on GEO/AI search best practices (structured data, content authority signals, schema markup, source citation patterns, llms.txt and similar emerging standards) and evaluate their applicability to company digital assets.
- Partner with IT and analytics teams to build or maintain lightweight tools, scripts, or dashboards that automate GEO monitoring where feasible.

Content Strategy & Updates

- Translate GEO monitoring findings into concrete, prioritized recommendations for content updates across owned digital properties (websites, HCP/patient portals, press releases, product pages, structured data).
- Partner with Marketing, Corporate Communications, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory/Legal to route recommended content changes through appropriate medical-legal-regulatory (MLR) review and approval workflows.
- Support implementation of approved content updates in collaboration with web/content teams, ensuring changes are applied consistently across channels and properly tagged/structured for machine readability.
- Maintain documentation of GEO findings, actions taken, and outcomes to demonstrate impact and support continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting

- Prepare regular reports and presentations summarizing AI solution performance and GEO monitoring insights for IT leadership and business stakeholders.
- Act as a liaison between IT, Marketing/Digital, Medical, and Regulatory/Compliance functions on matters involving AI tools and public-facing content accuracy.
- Contribute to the development of internal standards, playbooks, and SOPs governing GEO monitoring and AI solution support.

**Required Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business, Computer Science, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- 8-10+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Analyst, Digital Analyst, or similar hybrid technical/business role in a life sciences, pharma, or biotech commercial, medical, or healthcare organization.
- Demonstrated experience supporting or administering software/SaaS platforms, including gathering requirements, coordinating testing, and managing stakeholder communication.
- Familiarity with generative AI tools and platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini) and a genuine interest in how AI is changing search and content discovery.
- Conceptual understanding of comprehensive AI Tech Stack: Demonstrate conceptual understanding and practical application of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Graph RAG, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search Optimization (AISO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), NLP, Predictive Analytics, Multi-Hop Retrieval, Entity-Based SEO, Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Structures, Vector Embeddings, Prompt Engineering, Intent Analysis, Data Chunking, etc.
- Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and emerging GEO/AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) concepts, such as structured data, schema.org markup, content authority, and citation optimization.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize monitoring data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting findings to cross-functional and leadership audiences.
- Experience working within a regulated industry (life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare) with an understanding of MLR/promotional review processes, or strong willingness and ability to learn.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with content management systems (CMS), digital asset management (DAM), or web analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Sitecore, AEM).
- Familiarity with AI/LLM monitoring or brand-visibility tools, or experience building custom tracking using APIs, Python, or low-code automation tools.

# Senior Product Manager

Full-time

Hanwha Techwin America Inc

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7240146484643647525?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4361603749798852291&crId=US_0US_0)

**Title:** Sr. Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

Hanwha Vision America (HVA) is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company. HVA is an industry-leading provider of advanced network video surveillance products, including IP cameras, storage devices, and video management systems, founded on world-class technologies. We offer end-to-end security solutions and have achieved global success across a wide range of industry verticals, including retail, transportation, education, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and airports.

Hanwha Vision is seeking a Senior Product Manager (Hardware) to lead product strategy and execution for our B2B surveillance portfolio. You will collaborate with a cross-functional team, including fellow hardware and software product managers, R&D, Sales, Marketing, Field Engineering, and Technical Support, to drive product success from concept through end of life. You will work daily with our headquarters team in South Korea throughout the development process and product lifecycle. You will also mentor other product managers within the group.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Translate customer requirements and pain points into Market and Product Requirements Documents (MRD/PRD), defining detailed feature sets, use cases, and workflows.
- Own the full product lifecycle, from introduction to end of life, including market and competitive analysis, requirements gathering, and market validation.
- Conduct product testing and evaluation, and provide detailed feedback to global product management teams.
- Monitor market trends and emerging technologies, and identify opportunities for new products and features.
- Develop a deep understanding of the B2B surveillance market, including pricing, features, value propositions, and use cases.
- Drive the product development process and partner with Marketing Communications to bring new products and features to market.
- Gather feedback from customers and internal stakeholders and ensure it is accurately reflected in feature prioritization.
- Manage development schedules, identify risks and challenges, and ensure products meet requirements and launch on time.
- Serve as the subject matter expert on our products and their competitive positioning in the marketplace.
- Travel up to 20%, including international travel.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Computer, or a related discipline preferred).
- 8+ years of experience in the B2B electronics industry; security and surveillance experience is preferred
- Proven experience defining and managing APIs and SDKs, including working with engineering teams on interface specifications, documentation, and developer usability
- Hands-on experience writing AI/ML model requirements, such as defining use cases, performance targets (accuracy, latency, false-positive rates), training data needs, and edge deployment constraints
- Strong technical background in IP networking, with the ability to stay current on new technologies and industry trends.
- Hands-on problem solver who generates creative ideas and practical solutions.
- Comfortable representing the company at industry events, trade shows, and customer meetings.
- Positive, professional demeanor with the ability to build constructive relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and customers, including in challenging situations.
- Self-motivated and proactive, able to drive projects forward independently with minimal supervision.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organizational and time management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Fluency in both English and Korean (written and verbal)
- MBA or equivalent business degree

Total Quality Logistics

Descriptions & requirements
About the role:As a Product Manager, you’ll drive execution and own a defined area of responsibility within TQL’s technology ecosystem, which may include a product, application, workflow, or functional area. You’ll lead the understanding of customer and business needs and translate those needs into clear priorities, well‑defined requirements, and high‑quality user stories that guide development teams. You’ll partner closely with engineering and product leadership to define problems, shape solutions, and ensure delivery of outcomes that create meaningful results for users and the business.What’s in it for you:$86,000- $123,000 base salary Advancement opportunities with aggressive and structure career pathsA culture of continuous education and technical training with reimbursements availableHybrid work environment with the ability to work remotely 40 hours per monthComprehensive benefits packageHealth, dental and vision coverage401(k) with company matchPerks including employee discounts, financial wellness planning, tuition reimbursement and moreCertified Great Place to Work and voted a 2019-2026 Computerworld Best Places to Work in ITWhat you’ll be doing:Lead discovery to understand user workflows, pain points, and business processesDefine clear problem statements grounded in customer and business needsIdentify opportunities for meaningful impact within your assigned areaTranslate customer and business needs into well‑defined requirements and high‑quality user storiesBreak larger initiatives into structured, actionable workOwn and prioritize the backlog for your assigned areaMaintain backlog clarity, sequencing, and readinessIdentify and communicate dependencies, risks, and tradeoffsPartner with engineering, QA, design, and analytics to drive executionEnsure shared understanding of priorities, context, and intended value across stakeholdersUse data, user feedback, and delivery insights to evaluate progress and refine prioritiesPrepare materials for demos, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updatesWhat you need:You have a Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, data, or a related field, or equivalent experienceYou have 2-4 years of experience in product management, business analysis, software delivery, customer experience, or a related roleYou have experience working with agile development teamsYou are skilled at defining problems and connecting work to customer and business outcomesYou are a clear, concise communicator who partners effectively across technical and non‑technical teamsYou have an analytical mindset and can interpret user insights and delivery dataYou demonstrate strong ownership, organization, and accountability for resultsWhere you'll be: 4289 Ivy Pointe Blvd, Cincinnati, OH 45245Employment visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position. Applicants requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., F-1 STEM OPT, H-1B, TN, J1 etc.) will not be considered.About UsTotal Quality Logistics (TQL) is one of the largest freight brokerage firms in the nation. TQL connects customers with truckload freight that needs to be moved with quality carriers who have the capacity to move it. As a company that operates 24/7/365, TQL manages work-life balance with sales support teams that assist with accounting, and after hours calls and specific needs. At TQL, the opportunities are endless which means that there is room for career advancement and the ability to write your own paycheck. What’s your worth? Our open and transparent communication from management creates a successful work environment and custom career path for our employees. TQL is an industry-leader in the logistics industry with unlimited potential. Be a part of something big.Total Quality Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. AccuWeather is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Manager, Digital Subscriptions to grow our subscription offerings across mobile, web, and connected platforms. This role is instrumental in defining the roadmap for our digital subscription services, driving audience growth and revenue, and ensuring competitiveness in a fast-evolving landscape. Reporting directly to the SVP of Digital Strategy, the successful candidate will bring deep expertise in subscription ecosystems, customer segmentation, product packaging, pricing strategy, and cross-functional leadership.Key Responsibilities:· Define and execute end-to-end product and go-to-market strategies for digital subscription offerings across all consumer segments.· Conduct assessments of Total Addressable Market (TAM), perform customer segmentation and needs analysis, and develop pricing models and packaging strategies to drive business growth.· Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, marketing, sales, operations, and business development—to ensure a unified approach to product development and market execution.· Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to identify strategic opportunities and potential threats.· Build and maintain robust financial models to support decision-making, forecast performance, and prioritize investment opportunities.· Analyze user behavior and business performance using quantitative and qualitative data to inform product roadmap and feature prioritization.· Serve as a key voice in business development efforts, providing product insight and support for partnership and audience acquisition opportunities.· Communicate key findings, strategic recommendations, and performance updates to senior leadership and stakeholders.Qualifications:· 7+ years of experience in digital product management, with at least 5 years developing and executing go-to-market strategies.· Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Digital Media, or related field;
